title: Dilan Karaman’ın yarım kalan 25 Kasım yürüyüşü
content:
Geçen yıl Kasım günlerini hatırlar mısınız? Daha doğrusu Dilan Karaman’ı hatırlar mısınız? Önce, “hayatını kaybetti” diye duyuldu, sonra “intihar”, ardından “intihara sürükleme” ve bir dolu soru işareti, bilinmezlik, sorumlular, sorumsuzluklar, suçlamalar, yazılan raporlar, yazılmayan raporlar, soruşturmalar, tanıklar…


Yüzlerce insan Dilan için adalet istedi, sorumlular açığa çıksın dedi, talepler sıralandı…


Bugün, 25 Ekim’de ise bütün bunların ötesinde bir şey oldu. Dilan’ın ablası

Gönül Karaman

, “

Dünyanın En Güzel Dilan’ı / Dîlana Herî Xweşik a Cîhanê”

isimli bir derleme kitap hazırladı. Güldünya Yayınları etiketiyle okurla buluşan kitapta yoldaşının anlattığı Dilan’ı da okuyorsunuz, ailesinin hafızasında yaşayan Dilan’ı da. Fotoğraflarıyla, anılarıyla, geride bıraktığı izlerle…


Kitabın tanıtımı bugün Avcılar’daki Barış Manço Kültür Merkezi’nde yapıldı. Halkların Demokratik Kongresi (HDK) Eş Sözcüsü Meral Danış Beştaş, insan hakları savunucusu ve avukat Eren Keskin, Nimet Tanrıkulu, Kürt kadın siyasetçiler, arkadaşları ve ailesi Dilan’ı anmak için bir araya geldi.


Etkinlikte Dilan’ın yaşamından kesitler içeren kısa videolar da gösterildi. Onun ne kadar çalışkan olduğundan, yorulmak bilmediğinden, gülüşünden, yoldaşlarıyla kurduğu bağdan söz edildi.


Dilan’ı tanımayan biri olarak, anlatılanların çok daha ötesinde bir insan olduğunu hissettim. “Her ölüm erkendir” derler. Bu kez yalnızca bir ölümün erkenciliğini değil, ölümün ardından sorularla baş başa bırakılmanın, adalet arayışının ve bütün bunların içinde yalnız kalmanın ağırlığını da hissettim.


Peşimizi bırakmayan hisler


Ölenlerin ardından söylenen sözlerden biri de “Kel ölür, sırma saçlı olur”dur. İnsanlar öldükten sonra güzelleştirilir, eksikleri unutulur, anıları parlatılır. Ama Dilan için anlatılanlarda başka bir şey vardı. Onun yalnızca ölümünden sonra hatırlanan bir kadın olmadığını, yaşarken de bir mücadele yürüttüğünü, çalıştığını, ürettiğini, güldüğünü, sevdiğini ve hayatın içinde olduğunu görüyordunuz. Şüphesiz anlatılanlar, onu yalnızca kaybıyla tanımlamaya yetmiyordu.


Geçen yıl ölüm haberi duyulduktan sonra Dilan için ne kadar çok çaba gösterildi, neler yapıldı. Adalet talep edildi, sorular soruldu, açıklamalar yapıldı. Ancak Dilan’ın ve ailesinin yaşarken yalnız bırakıldığı hissi, bugün de peşimizi bırakmadı.


Salonda çok az insan vardı. 


“Baro seçimi vardı”, “yer uzaktı” ve benzeri gerekçeler sıralanabilir. Elbette herkesin kendi koşulları var. 


Dilan, içine düşürüldüğü duygulardan kurtulmak, sesini duyurmak için sesini yükseltmiş ama duyuramamıştı. Bugün, ölümünden sonra adını yaşatmak için bir araya gelenlerin önünde, kocaman konferans salonunun boş sıraları bana bu yalnızlık duygusunu yeniden hatırlattı. Gözyaşlarını tutmakta zorlanan kadınlar, ailesi, onu unutturmamak için emek verenler…


Gönül Karaman: Bu kitap, Dilan’ın yarım kalan 25 Kasım yürüyüşü


Dilan Karaman’ın ablası @GKaraman77252’ın bugün “Dünyanın en güzeli Dilan’ı” kitabının tanıtımında konuştu, dinlemenizi öneririm. https://t.co/wNiwlkXU6f


— Evrim Kepenek (@kepenekevrimm)

October 25, 2026


Dilan’ın ablası Gönül Karaman, kitabın hazırlanma sürecini anlatırken Dilan’ın anısını yaşatmak için bir araya gelen herkese teşekkür etti. Kitabın onun için taşıdığı anlamı, dayanışma ve ortak mücadele üzerinden anlattı:


“Herkes onun anılarının şahidi olarak o kitabın tamamlanmasına katkıda bulundu. Bunun bizim için anlamı çok büyük. Çünkü bu denli korkunç bir karanlık yine ancak bu renklerle aydınlanır. Bu renkler ki bizim sahiplendiğimiz dünyanın yaşanılacak yanı, tutunacak dalı, mücadelenin ışığı ve umududur.


“Aslında bu durum onun adıyla da çok uyumlu. Bu yüzdendir ki dünyanın en güzel Dilan’ı odur. Biran, Türkçede halay demektir. Halay çekmek kolektif bir eylemdir. İnsanlar bütün renkleriyle, stranlarıyla el ele tutuşmasını bilir. Yüz yüze bakar, adımlarla birlikte atılır ve en güzel şarkılar, en güzel ritimlerle tek bir ses olup söylenir.


“Dilan isminin bütün özelliklerini gerçekten de ruhunda taşıyordu. Onun anısına dair herkesin kendi ritmi ve rengiyle kalem tuttuğu bu eser, tam da onun isteyeceği gibi koroların tuttuğu bir dayanışma içerisinde hayata geçiyor. Bu yolculukta kalemleriyle onun yürüyüşünü sürdüren bütün yoldaşlarıma yürekten teşekkür ederim.


“Bu eser, onun yarım kalan, aslında hiç kalmayacak 25 Kasım yürüyüşüdür.”


Gönül Karaman, kitabın gelirinin bir bölümünü Güldünya Yayınları’na, bir bölümünü ise kadına yönelik şiddetle mücadele …

author: Unknown
title: Iranian regime sentences Van resident Cenk Demir to 5 years in prison
content:
The Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) stated that a regime court in the city of Urmia had sentenced Cenk Demir, originally from Van (Wan), to five years in prison on charges of “membership in opposition groups.”


According to the statement, Demir was arrested in Urmia approximately eight months ago. After being questioned for months at a security detention centre in the city, he was transferred to Urmia Central Prison.


It was reported that, following the announcement of the verdict, Demir was transferred to the Ershad ward, where political prisoners are held.

author: EDRi
title: Draconian access block orders in Turkey
content:
Court orders to block access to X accounts in Turkey reached an unprecedented number in September 2026. In this blog, EDRi-member Alternatif Bilisim detail the crackdown on civil rights defenders and independent media in the country, and call on public authorities to reconsider block orders and protect fundamental rights.

By Alternatif Bilisim (guest author) · October 29, 2026

Court orders to block access to X accounts in Turkey reached an unprecedented number in September 2026, followed by the closure of T24, an independent news website. According to data from the EngelliWeb project of the Freedom of Expression Association (İFÖD), X blocked at least 1,270 accounts. In comparison, a total of 995 accounts were blocked in the entire year of 2025. In fact, the website of EngelliWeb, which tracks and documents online censorship in Turkey, was also blocked on 1 October 2026. Authoritarian measures and alarming levels of censorship in the country are increasingly eroding freedom of expression.

The common factor in all decisions related to access block orders is Article 8/A of Law No. 5651. This article allows the right of life, the safety of life and property of the persons, the protection of national security and public order, the prevention of crime or the protection of the internet contents or the prevention of access to the internet content. Several restrictions on access blocks in September cited grounds such as national security or protection of public order under 8/A.

Article 8/A was introduced by the government as an arrangement that was supposed to be implemented in exceptional cases, but its use has been gradually expanding. The use of this article is also being combined with the new provisions on family values under the so-called “My Family is Safe” investigations, which have led to a brutal crackdown on LGBTQ+ and HIV advocacy groups in Turkey.

EDRi-member Alternatif Bilisim condemns this act by the Turkish authorities and the complicity of X on the shadow bans. Turkey is increasingly witnessing an ideological surge on critical opinion and its clear consequences for the journalism landscape as well as digital spaces at large.

According to Engelliweb, in September 2026, many different accounts – from LGBTQ+ organisations and activists to journalists, academics to economists, from women’s organisations to individual users – were impacted by the access blocks. A few examples of note are the accounts of Evrensel, a socialist newspaper; Amnesty International Turkey; Academics for Peace; and the Media and Law Studies Association.

In the second half of September, social media posts on capital markets have also a key focus of blocks due to alleged cause of fear and panic in the society. A major capital-markets scandal in Turkey involved widespread market manipulation by asset managers who allegedly inflated fund values using worthless “junk stocks,” leading to the liquidation of 131 funds and affecting about 455,000 investors. Authorities arrested over 114 people and froze assets as part of the investigation into fraud and criminal organization charges.

A more recent disproportionate measure has been the closure of a prominent independent news website T24 and its social media accounts after the justice ministry reported that they had published 118 items during the previous year which the court classified as “LGBTQ propaganda”. The X accounts of Independent News Network Bianet, as well as several of its reporters have also been banned due to court orders citing national security and protection of public order.

Court decisions on access to an account does not mean that the account will automatically become invisible in X from Turkey. The decision must also be implemented by the platform. X did not implement all the decisions. According to the IFÖD’s findings, 1,139 of the at least 1,270 accounts (around 90 percent) that were blocked in September were made invisible from Turkey by X. According to X’s official policy, the company can only block access to certain content or accounts in the respective country when it receives a valid and appropriate legal request from an competent authority. The account is not closed globally in this case. Co-founder of EngelliWeb, Yaman Akdeniz, argues that platforms have become more harmonious with the demands of the authorities in Turkey, especially after March 19, 2025, following the arrest of Istanbul mayor and presidential candidate of the main opposition party (CHP), Ekrem …

author: Julius Gavroche
title: October 17th, or the Return of Playfulness
content:
from

lundimatin

 #539, 26/10/2026


“Opportunistic delinquency,” “holiday-strike,” “lack of political maturity,” “childish cosplay,” “reckless destruction,” “acts of rage” — all these hostile terms used to discredit the ongoing uprising have given rise to their political antonyms: “material reappropriation,” “demands for better study conditions,” “political awareness,” “joyful staging,” and so on. October 17th has been the occasion for a prolific and all-encompassing production of a staggering number of counter-interpretations, theoretical texts, and hypotheses about what drives the movement. Yet, a subterranean dimension to its actions, omnipresent throughout, still seems to be ignored: playfulness [

le ludique

]. Without returning to a thorough examination of the underlying causes of the movement, nor to a prescriptive reading of its aftermath—most often guided by the intention to “manage” the movement—we wanted here to recapture the passion at work behind the riotous gestures and the high school fervour.


“Je te tiens, tu me tiens, par la barbichette, le premier de nous deux qui rira aura une tapette!”

[“I hold you, you hold me, by the goatee, the first one to laugh will get a light slap!”)

[1]


The Game Begins


Our hypothesis, which can coexist with others, posits that the “playful” comes into play as a uniquely effective concept for understanding the fundamentally joyful riotous activity around which the subjectivities of those participating in the insurrection were emotionally bound and organised.


Whether in the charivaris, carnivals, or parades of high school students dressed as comic book superheroes, the fact remains: play coupled with laughter constitutes an undeniable domain of tactics and stratagems allowing one to temporarily break free from the grip of a dominant power. But this playful aspect is neither a simple formal reversal of positions nor a powerless parody of power. It is a refutation in action of learned protest techniques and other demands. The weariness of traditional activist circles is left behind, and already a new horizon of joyful and creative acts is emerging.


The high school students’ strategic skill lies in reusing codes deemed harmless and far too childish to be repressed or even considered: superheroes, costumes, TikTok trends, and so on. Yet, each time, they repurpose these codes in a context of assault and offensives, leading to physical or non-physical confrontations with law enforcement. For example, Captain America launches an attack followed by hundreds of individuals dressed in black. These actions further expose the fundamental illegitimacy of police officers using force. And besides, what can a police officer do against a Batman who starts dancing in front of him? Get enraged, strike, or experience boredom, or endure his docility (the latter two obligations usually being reserved for high school students). How do you stop a battle of auras, the apotheosis of absurdity and humour? By no other means than as a spoilsport. One last thing: what can a police officer do when faced with a left-wing activist, some kind of proselytizer, megaphone in hand, shouting the same old slogans? Ignore them like any other piece of scenery.


Rediscovered Lucidity(ies)


One of the obvious attributes of the complicity present before and during October 17th (Gen Z, students, temporary workers, suburbanites, subordinates, Yellow Vests—in short, subjectivities in the process of proletarianisation) is their propensity for the “playful”. The innocuous act of triggering an aura battle, like smashing a shop window, even if they share no fundamental equivalence, manifests this same playful relationship to the metropolitan imposition of a commercial space. It would be wrong to oppose acts of rage and destruction to the expression of newfound joy, or in other words, acts of looting and arson to role-playing, aura battles, and dressing up as superheroes. They condense and stem from the same affects: in short, a joy in destruction or the anticipation of destroying with joy. Against the contained, regular, and monotonous movements and displacements of the urban and commercial world, always assigned to a goal, they also oppose and demonstrate the here and now possibility of free activity, of a reclaiming of space, without a stated goal or pre-established function. In

Homo Ludens

, Johan Huizinga defines play as follows:


Summing up the formal characteristics of play we might call it a free …

author: Unknown
title: Comunicato delle cinque attiviste italiane arrestate e deportate da Israele
content:
Riceviamo e pubblichiamo il comunicato delle cinque attiviste italiane arrestate lo scorso 22 ottobre dalle forze di occupazione israeliane a Masafer Yatta, nella Cisgiordania occupata, e successivamente espulse dal Paese. Le cinque si trovavano insieme ad altre sei persone internazionali in visita a una famiglia palestinese quando sono state fermate da coloni israeliani e successivamente detenute dalla polizia. Nel comunicato denunciano le condizioni della detenzione, il ruolo delle autorità italiane e, soprattutto, la sistematica violenza dell’occupazione israeliana contro la popolazione palestinese, che continua a essere oscurata dall’attenzione mediatica riservata agli attivisti internazionali.


Di seguito il comunicato integrale.


Siamo le cinque ragazze italiane arrestate ed deportate dalle forze di occupazione israeliane.

Il 22 ottobre undici attivistə internazionali, oltre a noi una tedesca, un britannico, un irlandese, uno statunitense, un’austriaca e un’ ungherese, sono statə detenutə da coloni israeliani e poi dalla polizia israeliana mentre visitavano una famiglia palestinese a Masafer Yatta, nella West Bank occupata.

Non c’è davvero differenza tra esercito e coloni: in diversi posti viene delegato proprio a questi ultimi il controllo del territorio. E quando non è così, la comunicazione e la complicità tra esercito, polizia e coloni è più che stretta.


La stampa racconta che la Farnesina ha ottenuto il nostro rimpatrio. Ma qui non c’è proprio nulla da ottenere: noi non volevano essere espulse, volevamo restare in solidarietà con il popolo palestinese.


Quello che la Farnesina dovrebbe ottenere è, al contrario, una spiegazione delle ragioni per cui siamo state arrestate e detenute per 48 ore, rinchiuse in delle celle senza avere accesso a un processo e a contattare i nostri affetti.


Il governo dovrebbe chiedere perché nei territori palestinesi persone internazionali non possano stare accanto alle famiglie indigene mentre raccolgono le olive nella loro terra e cercano semplicemente di vivere la propria quotidianità. Come mai le loro case e le loro terre vengono arbitrariamente sottratte, occupate, dichiarate zone di addestramento militare, cacciando le famiglie che ci abitano da sempre.


Ci chiediamo inoltre come sia possibile che criminali di guerra possano godersi le vacanze in Italia, all’interno di resort privati, scortati da Digos e polizia senza subire alcuna conseguenza.


Come sempre nei media europei, fa notizia l’arresto di persone internazionali e non la violenza sistemica che i Palestinesi subiscono ogni giorno dalla Nakba del 1948 e ancora prima.


Le famiglie palestinesi vivono sotto un regime di apartheid e terrore imposto dall’occupazione israeliana e sotto la costante minaccia di espulsione e pulizia etnica. Vedono negati i permessi per costruire le proprie case o di accedere alle loro terre, dove i coloni indisturbati possono pascolare i loro greggi rubati ai palestinesi e costruire strade e colonie illegali sotto la legge internazionale. Le persone sono tagliate fuori dalle proprie fonti di acqua, i loro pozzi, le strade e le case, vengono distrutti. Una violenza costante per costringere la gente ad abbandonare la propria terra.


Non possiamo evitare di pensare alle proteste dei contadini e gli autotrasportatori del Sud Italia, che piangono vicino ai loro alberi di ulivo e al fatto che il lavoro di una vita non permetta loro di arrivare a fine mese. Non possiamo dimenticare delle migliaia di armi che escono dalle industrie della Leonardo a partecipazione statale e alle innumerevoli mobilitazioni contro il riarmo che hanno invaso le strade, le scuole, i porti e le stazioni durante questi anni. Davanti a tutto questo, il Governo è rimasto in silenzio. Al posto di ascoltare le proteste contro il carovita e dare delle risposte alle piazze, continua a finanziare la macchina di morte che porta avanti il genocidio, l’occupazione e lo sterminio in Palestina.


Quello che ci è successo è inaccettabile ma la situazione delle persone palestinesi è cento volte peggiore. Sono arrestate ogni giorno, nessun ministero degli esteri interviene per loro conto, nessun media si mobilita in loro difesa. Anche bambine e bambini sono detenuti illegalmente nelle carceri israeliane al cui interno gli vengono inflitte violenze fisiche, psicologiche e sessuali e nelle quali spesso muoiono, nel silenzio assordante del mondo.

Lo sappiamo bene, anche perchè durante la nostra detenzione abbiamo ricevuto …

author: Unknown
title: Antalya'da 4 işçinin öldüğü hortum felaketi: Müteahhit ve şantiye şefi tutuklandı
content:
Antalya — Antalya'nın Kepez ilçesinde 4 işçinin hayatını kaybettiği hortum felaketiyle ilgili başlatılan soruşturma kapsamında gözaltına alınan 4 kişiden müteahhit ve şantiye şefi tutuklandı, diğer 2 kişi ise adli kontrol şartıyla serbest bırakıldı.

Kepez ilçesi Fevzi Çakmak Mahallesi 6199 Sokak'taki şantiyede, 26 Ekim'de saat 23.00 sıralarında şiddetli yağışla birlikte hortum çıktı. İşçilerin bulunduğu 2 konteyneri savuran hortum, yaklaşık 40 metre yüksekliğindeki kule vincin de devrilmesine neden oldu. İhbar üzerine olay yerine sevk edilen ekiplerin çalışmasıyla konteynerlerdeki işçiler çıkarılarak hastaneye kaldırıldı.

Olayda işçiler Aycan Kılınç (30) ile Suriyeli Muhammet Mustafa el Naim, İsa Musa el Nevaf ve Selahattin Muhammed el Naim hayatını kaybetti, inşaatın bekçisi Cumali Kurak ise yaralandı. Hortumda şantiyedeki konteynerlerin parçaları etrafa savruldu, çevredeki bir sitenin güvenlik duvarı ve yakındaki bir okulun çatısı ile bazı araçlar hasar gördü.

Hayatını kaybeden 4 işçinin cansız bedenleri, olay yerindeki incelemelerin ardından Antalya Adli Tıp Kurumu morguna konuldu. Aycan Kılınç’ın cenazesi, işlemlerinin ardından dün yakınlarına teslim edilerek memleketi Niğde’ye gönderildi. Suriyeli Muhammet Mustafa el Naim, İsa Musa el Nevaf ve Selahattin Muhammed el Naim'in ise kimlik belgelerinin bulunmaması nedeniyle kimlik tespit çalışmalarının sürdüğü öğrenildi.

Antalya Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı tarafından olayla ilgili başlatılan soruşturma kapsamında müteahhit Mevlüt Ç. ve eşi Ş.Ç. ile şantiye şefi Deniz K. ve iş güvenliği uzmanı İ.A, gözaltına alındı. 4 kişi, emniyetteki işlemlerinin ardından adliyeye getirildi. Mevlüt Ç. ve şantiye şefi Deniz K. hazırlanan bilirkişi raporu doğrultusunda 'Birden fazla kişinin taksirle ölümüne sebebiyet vermek' suçundan sevk edildikleri hakimlikçe tutuklandı. Ş.Ç. ve İ.A. ise adli kontrolle serbest bırakıldı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Prohíben alojar detenidos en un jaulón de la Comisaría 1a de Bahía Blanca
content:
La Sala 1 de la Cámara de Apelación y Garantías del departamento judicial Bahía Blanca revocó, con el voto de los jueces Christian Alberto Yesari y Gustavo Ángel Barbieri, el fallo del Tribunal Oral Criminal 2 departamental que había rechazado un habeas corpus colectivo presentado por la Comisión Provincial por la Memoria (CPM), en su carácter de Mecanismo Local de Prevención de la Tortura (MLPT). En ese sentido, la Cámara prohibió el alojamiento de personas en el sector denominado comúnmente “jaulón” de la Comisaría 1

a

 de la Policía Bonaerense, por el agravamiento de las condiciones de detención. Se trata de un pequeño espacio enrejado y sin techo, y las personas pasan la noche a la intemperie en camastros de cemento, sin poder ducharse y sin elementos de limpieza. En su apelación, la CPM había cuestionado la contradicción del tribunal de origen que reconoció la inhabitabilidad del sector pero evitó dictar la prohibición total de alojar personas.


El habeas corpus colectivo en favor de los detenidos en la Comisaría 1

a

 de Bahía Blanca había sido interpuesto el 30 de enero pasado, tras una jornada de monitoreo en la que se habían constatado gravosas condiciones de alojamiento y del régimen de vida en los calabozos, y principalmente en un pequeño espacio cerrado llamado “jaulón”: sin techo, módulos sanitarios, colchón, agua corriente y otros elementos mínimos de habitabilidad. De las 9 personas detenidas en esa dependencia, una había pasado toda la noche en el jaulón y los demás permanecían amontonados en los calabozos.


Tres días después, el 2 de febrero, se realizó una jornada de constatación judicial a instancias del Tribunal Oral Criminal 2 de Bahía Blanca; las magistradas que asistieron al lugar pudieron observar lo mismo que lo denunciado por la CPM en el habeas corpus colectivo. En efecto, los testimonios recogidos indicaron la falta de colchones, asistencia médica y de elementos de higiene personal y limpieza de los calabozos, escasa cantidad de comida provista por la dependencia policial, poca variedad y de mala calidad, entre otros agravantes.


Sin embargo, en su resolución del 4 de febrero, el mismo tribunal rechazó la acción de habeas corpus colectivo y se limitó a dictar “la prohibición estricta de alojar personas en el sector denominado normalmente como ‘jaulón’ por más de 12 horas, toda vez que no reúne las condiciones mínimas para recibirlos dignamente (…) Ordenar la entrega de colchones a todas las personas alojadas en la dependencia, ya que la autoridad ha admitido que existen suficientes pero se desconoce por qué razón hay quienes duermen en el piso”.


Es por ese motivo que la CPM presentó un recurso de apelación por considerar que se produjo una deficiente valoración de la prueba, teniendo en cuenta que todos los actores intervinientes en el proceso -incluso las autoridades policiales de la Comisaría- reconocieron que el ‘jaulón’ se utilizó y se sigue utilizando de forma constante y habitual.


Para el organismo de derechos humanos no resulta razonable ni legítima la resolución del tribunal, para el que aparece como jurídicamente válido que se alojen personas en un espacio “a la intemperie” que no cuenta con baño, suministro de agua corriente ni calefacción.


Al decir en su fallo que “…estamos en condiciones de concluir que tal agravamiento al día de hoy no existe, y que la acción de habeas corpus como tal no puede prosperar”, el tribunal cae en la contradicción lógica sobre sus propios razonamientos y concluye en una arbitrariedad, debido a que tanto en la jornada de constatación judicial como en sus propia resolución admite las características de inhabitabilidad de ese espacio.


El 19 de octubre, finalmente, se conoció el fallo de la Sala 1 de la Cámara de Apelación y Garantías, firmado por los jueces Christian Alberto Yesari y Gustavo Ángel Barbieri, que revocó el fallo del TOC 2 de Bahía Blanca y dispuso la prohibición de alojar personas en el sector denominado comúnmente “jaulón” de la Comisaría 1

a

 por los argumentos denunciados originalmente por la CPM y verificados en distintas ocasiones durante la tramitación de la causa.


Las comisarías bonaerenses continúan siendo lugares inhabitables donde se reproducen graves violaciones de derechos humanos. Si bien la población alojada en ellas descendió hasta 1.386 personas en 2025, en el mes de septiembre del 2026 trepó a 1.733 detenidos en 1.159 lugares informados por el Ministerio de Seguridad. Esos cupos no cumplen con los …

author: Thorin Klosowski
title: Victory! You Can Now Exclude Apps from Siri AI
content:
In the most recent update to Apple’s devices, iOS 27.2, the company has introduced a new setting to “Exclude Apps” from Siri AI, fulfilling one of our asks from

our Encrypt It Already campaign earlier this year

.


One of our main concerns with new AI features on devices is how those features interact with end-to-end encrypted content, particularly with secure messaging apps. Many AI features require cloud processing, and despite

privacy protections engineered into these systems

, the content of secure messaging apps may leave a user’s device without their knowledge. That changes the privacy concerns around using those tools. In a perfect world, users would be able to put a barrier up to ensure data from certain apps doesn’t leave the device. Here was our initial ask:


You should be able to tell the operating system’s AI to not access an app, even if that comes at the “cost” of missing out on some features. The setting should be straightforward and easy to understand in ways the Gemini and Apple Intelligence controls currently are not.


At launch, we found the settings to control Siri AI’s app access

behavior pretty confusing

. You had to toggle several options to block Siri AI off from accessing an app, or disable Siri AI entirely. Turning off Siri AI and

reverting to Siri Classic

 is, for now, still a good option if you’d prefer to use the older version.


The most recent update is far more clear and does more to protect your data. And, just as expected, it comes at the cost of some features. That’s a good thing, actually. The features not working shows that the new setting is effective. 


Here’s how to add apps to the exclusion list, once you’ve updated to 27.2:


Open

Settings

 >

Siri

 >

Excluded Apps


Tap “Add Apps” and select any apps you’d like to add to the exclusion list


Now Siri AI cannot access the contents of the app. Excluding an app also means you may lose some features. For example, if you exclude the Apple Messages app, you will no longer be able to have Siri AI read or respond to messages for you. Even the “onscreen awareness” feature, where you invoke Siri and ask it for information about what you’re currently looking at, will not work anymore. For example, if you exclude Signal, you cannot invoke Siri and ask it to discern any information in the Signal app. You’ll just get these messages:


What’s the State of This on Android?


This update from Apple is also a good excuse to check in on the process on Android. It has improved a little, but is

not as straightforward

 as Apple’s new settings, and lacks the ability to set the screen context feature per-app. But you do have some control over what Gemini can access: 


Open up the Gemini app


Tap your user photo, then

Settings > Personal Intelligence

 >

Connected Apps


Revoke access to any apps you do not want Gemini to have access to


This process seems to work well enough for some data and we like that it’s opt in, but it’s not exactly intuitive. For example, Signal doesn’t appear there because Signal doesn’t support Gemini’s app access feature at all. That means Gemini can’t access the content of Signal directly, which is good. 


But Gemini can read notifications if you’ve enabled the “

Device Assistance

” Connected App (which you likely have, since that also enables basic features, like setting a timer—check under

Settings

 >

Personal Intelligence

 >

Connected Apps

), and it can use screen context unless you’ve disabled the

Device controls

 >

Screen context

 > “Use screen and app data” option in the Gemini Settings. These two features may access the contents of the Signal app or notifications, if you choose to use them. We’d prefer a more hard-lined approach that reduces the chances of user error here: Google should give users the ability to turn these features off per app.


Apple clearly understands that some users want stronger controls over what Siri AI can and cannot access. But we think they should go further and offer the option to only use “on device” AI features, similar to

what Samsung offered with its Galaxy AI

. We’re happy to see this change and think all operating systems need to consider similar controls moving forward.

author: Kodao Productions
title: The risks journalists face (2)
content:
The “secret” complainant in the cyberlibel case against tabloid columnist Philip Lustre Jr. — who was arrested on Saturday, Oct. 24, 2026, right at the venue of the Saturday News Forum at Dapo Restaurant in Quezon City – turned out to be Atty. Mans Carpio, the once-proud stockholder of Cale88 Food, which was exporting banana chips to Hong Kong, China and other countries. Atty. Carpio was apparently erased from the ownership structure of Cale88 in July 2026, just as the impeachment trial of his wife, Sara Zimmerman Duterte Carpio, commenced at the Senate.


Based on the court documents, the complaint stemmed from Lustre’s March 6, 2026 Facebook post which alleged that Carpio “spent” P300-million to finance the operation of the 18 Marines who claimed to have delivered billions of pesos from flood control projects to lawmakers. The post read:

“SUMUKA si Mans Carpio ng P300-M sa operasyon ng Marines: P150-M kay Mike; P50-M kay Levi; at P5-M sa bawat isa sa 18 Marines?”

 (Did Mans Carpio cough up P300 million for the Marines’ operation: P150 million to Mike, P50 million to Levi, and P5 million each to the 18 Marines?)

[Mike probably referred to former Congressman and Secretary Michael Defensor and Levi to Atty. Levi Baligod—ed.]


Since what Lustre posted was a question to which Carpio could respond on Facebook, it is doubtful whether the Davao City prosecutor considered the difference between a categorical statement accusing Carpio of bribery and a question that seeks corroboration or denial. Thus, Lustre’s counsel, Atty. Dino de Leon, might as well question why he or she gave short shrift to the respondent. However, based on the Davao City prosecutor’s reading, the written online statement “taken in its plain, natural, and ordinary meaning, directly imputes upon Atty. Manases R. Carpio.”


De Leon noted that Lustre was never informed about the complaint that was given due course in March 2026. In eight months, the Davao City prosecutors failed to know Lustre’s residence and thus could not serve him with subpoenae to compel him to contest Carpio’s allegations. Too convenient for Mans to have all the chances to pursue a case against Lustre without the benefit of a reply. Everything was ex parte and such proceedings would normally warrant dismissal in other jurisdictions. Miffed by the tactics of the other party, de Leon said: “We will confront this case properly and we reserve our client’s right to file the appropriate counter-charges.”


For posing a question, Davao City prosecutors now want Lustre to be on the dock to answer charges that he had willfully and maliciously imputed a criminal act on Carpio in violation of Sec. (4C) 4 of the Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012, also known as Republic Act No. 10175. Lustre was in the dark about the identity of the complainant, telling reporters that he suspected it was either Mans or Rep. Pulong Duterte. It was only a copy of the information was sent to de Leon that they finally pinpointed Mans, who is still grieving after his father, Atty. Lucas Carpio, died.


Journalists are mourning, too, over the conduct of the Lustre arrest and the dubious process that led to the Oct. 24, 2026 apprehension at a Quezon City news forum. With the information kept in some black hole, there was no way for the accused to reply and demolish the allegations lodged against him. Such puerile tactics as “failing” to determine the address of Lustre and merely listing his “residence” as the editorial offices of a Makati-based newspaper, are part of the scheme to make it hard for him to prepare his defense.


Moreover, Judge Retrina Espe Fuentes of Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 10 in Davao City, who signed the arrest warrant for Lustre, was the same judge who issued the arrest warrant for Davao Death Squad (DDS) whistleblower Arturo Lascañas in 2017 after he turned his back on Rodrigo Duterte, who was sitting as president then. Lascañas tagged Duterte as the architect of the “tokhang” murders. Eventually, Lascañas fled the country and revealed everything he knew about the slaughter of 30,000 people during the anti-drug war as well as the murders of the enemies of the Duterte political dynasty. In 2022, Fuentes also signed the arrest warrant for Walden Bello for the cyberlibel case filed against him by Sara Duterte’s cherished staff member Jefry Tupas.


Legal experts said that from the looks of it, the case may have to pass through the eye of a needle before it earns a tad of gravitas. From the …

title: La bande à « Balance ton Claude »
content:
Nous avons déjà longuement abordé les ressorts de l'« affaire Thélyson Orélien » dans nos pages (nous renvoyons, entre autres, à

cet excellent texte de Jean Claude Noel

). L'enquête qui suit porte sur ses délateurs, la bande à « Balance ton Claude » du nom du compte X à l'origine de la polémique. On y découvre que l'affaire Thélyson Orélien, est un double écran de fumée qui masque une convergence d'intérêts, financiers, idéologiques et géopolitiques, entre l'industrie de l'IA, les libertariens de la Silicon Valley, les christo-fascistes de l'administration Trump, et leurs imitateurs bien-de-chez-nous.


« Démarche complètement apolitique », « lanceur d'alerte », anonymat nécessaire pour éviter les attaques

ad hominem

… Toutes ces auto-justifications offertes par la bande à « Balance ton Claude », qui est derrière la polémique Thélyson Orélien, servent à ripoliner une opération idéologique, menée par un groupe de jeunes « libéraux-conservateurs » (doux euphémisme), très actifs dans l'espace médiatique, depuis les colonnes du Figaro, et les fabriques à propagande du projet Périclès. En outre, ces alarmes hypocrites s'inscrivent dans les récits

IApocalyptiques

 déployés par l'industrie pour faire gonfler investissements publics et privés. Une bulle profitant surtout aux nouveaux technoligarques, qui sont prêts à jeter la démocratie et l'humanité entière dans le chaudron de la valorisation et de la domination sans partage.


Les problèmes posés par la rédaction

I

A

ssistée

cachent une autre forme d'imposture : les allégations de neutralité politique répétées par la bande à « Balance ton Claude ». Une fine équipe, composée de cinq membres, d'après le premier accusateur anonyme sorti du bois

 [

1

]

, et qui n'a pas eu droit à la même attention que Thélyson Orélien.


«

Notre démarche était complètement apolitique

 [

2

]


 »

, déclarait ainsi Samuel Fitoussi dans

Le Point

, après avoir tombé le masque. Pourtant, le profil de nos Claudettes risque d'affoler votre détecteur à

bullshit

. Pas besoin du logiciel Pangram, vous allez voir, pour confondre ces immenses tartufes, présentés comme des «

lanceurs d'alerte

ayant

 l'amour de la vérité chevillé au coeur

et dénonçant les impostures intellectuelles

 [

3

]

 ».


Samuel Fitoussi


Commençons par vous donner une idée de l'honnêteté intellectuelle de M. Fitoussi. Quelques heures après avoir lancé la polémique sur le livre de Thélyson Orélien depuis le compte X « Balance ton Claude » (encore anonyme à ce moment-là), le chroniqueur du

Figaro

 intervient sur Radio J, où il déclare : «

comme aujourd'hui, le RN n'est pas un parti particulièrement violent ou antisémite ou quoi que ce soit, [renvoyer dos à dos les extrêmes] c'est en fait banaliser la dangerosité de cette gauche pro-Hamas...

 »


La journaliste lui fait alors remarquer que l'extrême-droite est quand même «

très proche de l'AfD, un parti néo-nazi

 ». Réponse de Samuel Fitoussi : «

J'ai beaucoup de critiques à l'égard de ces partis. Pour le RN, par exemple, je les trouve étatistes, socialistes, relativement incompétents

 […]

mais je pense qu'il faut reconnaître que les choses ont évolué, que le RN n'est plus le RN d'il y a 30 ans, et c'est même plus le RN d'il y a dix ans, qui voulait sortir de l'Union européenne, et c'est plus le RN antisémite

 [

4

]

 ».

L

'amour de la vérité chevillé au cœur

, on vous dit.


Par ailleurs, l'intérêt de M. Fitoussi pour les implications de l'IA générative n'est pas pure curiosité, étant donné qu'il travaille pour le fonds d'investissement FRST CAPITAL, spécialisé dans l'industrie naissante du

machine learning

(un des domaines informatiques que l'on trouve derrière la formule générique « IA », et dont les avancées ont notamment permis le développement des « grands modèles de langage » – ou

LLM

 – comme le célèbre ChatGPT).


Incidemment, FRST CAPITAL est une ancienne filiale d'OTIUM CAPITAL, la holding de Pierre-Edouard Stérin, milliardaire christo-libertarien qui utilise ses gains pour financer un projet de conquête politique par l'extrême-droite, baptisé « Périclès » (pour Patriotes, Enracinés, Résistants, Identitaires, Chrétiens, Libéraux, Européens, Souverainistes), et doté d'un budget de 150 millions d'euros

 [

5

]

.


Cerise sur le gâteau : FIRST CAPITAL n'investit pas seulement dans les « laboratoires d'IA », mais également dans la fabrique d'opinion, en produisant des sondages douteux sur la popularité d'Elon Musk ou …

title: Terminal Kadıköy’ün reklam ekranı hack’lendi: “Bu bina kent suçudur”
content:
İstanbul'un Kadıköy Söğütlüçeşme’deki Terminal Kadıköy’de bulunan bir reklam ekranı, “BU BİNA KENT SUÇUDUR” yazısıyla hack’lendi. Kent hakkı savunucuları, deprem toplanma alanı ve yeşil alanın alışveriş merkezine (AVM) dönüştürülmesine tepki göstererek kentlerin her alanının kâr maksimizasyonuna göre planlandığını vurguladı.


ETHA’daki habere göre, Söğütlüçeşme Tren İstasyonu’nun viyadük altındaki alanında kurulan Terminal Kadıköy, Nisan 2025’ten bu yana işletiliyor. Açıldığı günden bu yana onlarca dükkânın faaliyet gösterdiği alan, yeni bir tüketim merkezine dönüştü.


Kent hakkı savunucuları, ekoloji örgütleri ve Kadıköylüler, projeye karşı yıllardır itirazlarını sürdürüyor. Haydarpaşa Dayanışması, projeyi “soylulaştırma merkezi” olarak nitelendirerek “Kamusal alanlar ticarileşiyor, bu bir kent suçudur” açıklamasını yapmıştı.


Savunucular, AVM’ye dönüştürülen alanın geçmişte sokakta yaşayan hayvanların kent sakinleri tarafından beslendiği geniş bir yeşil alan olduğunu belirtiyor. Bölgenin yıllarca “izbe bir alan, güvensiz bir yer” olarak tanımlandığını aktaran kent hakkı savunucuları, bu söylemle projeye toplumsal rıza oluşturulmaya çalışıldığını ifade ediyor.


500’den fazla ağaç kesildi


Proje kapsamında bölgede 500’den fazla ağaç kesildi. Kent hakkı savunucuları, Söğütlüçeşme’deki alanın deprem toplanma alanı niteliği taşıdığını ve projenin bu işlevi fiilen ortadan kaldırdığını belirtiyor.


Savunucular, “Hem bir deprem toplanma alanı hem kentsel bir yeşil alanın tümü, bir avuç AVM’ye kurban edildi” diyerek kamusal alanın sermayeye peşkeş çekilmesine tepki göstermişti.


Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği Bakanlığı ise proje için “ÇED Gerekli Değildir” kararı vermişti.


Terminal Kadıköy sonrası Kadıköy’de artan yoğunluk ve trafik baskısı


14 Nisan 2026


(EMK)

title: Siber Güvenlik Başkanlığı'ndan kritik güvenlik uyarısı
content:
Siber Güvenlik Başkanlığı, dünya genelinde yaygın olarak kullanılan PHP yazılım altyapısında kritik güvenlik açıkları tespit edildiğini belirterek şu açıklamayı yaptı “Dünya genelinde yaygın olarak kullanılan PHP yazılım altyapısında kritik güvenlik açıkları tespit edilmiştir.

Başkanlığımız, söz konusu zafiyetlerin oluşturabileceği risklerin erken tespiti ve olası etkilerinin sınırlandırılması amacıyla ulusal ölçekte güvenlik taramalarını başlatmış, ilgili kurum ve kuruluşlara acil güvenlik bildirimlerini iletmiştir.

Kamu kurumlarımızın, kritik altyapı işletmecilerimizin ve özel sektör kuruluşlarımızın sistemlerini gözden geçirerek gerekli güvenlik güncellemelerini ivedilikle uygulamaları önem taşımaktadır.

Dijital altyapılarımızın güvenliği ve kritik hizmetlerin sürekliliği için ulusal düzeyde koordinasyon ve önleyici güvenlik çalışmalarımız sürmektedir.”

author: Blanca Missé
title: As More Unions Oppose ICE and Israel, the Right Is Cracking Down
content:
The right is trying to gain access to labor unions’ minutes, membership lists, and Zoom chats.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

On September 22, The Free Press attacked the California Faculty Association (CFA), which represents about 29,000 faculty, librarians, counselors, and coaches across the California State University (CSU) system. Drawing on private discussions about a proposed Jewish caucus, including communications from a union Zoom meeting, the article accused CFA of antisemitism. How those communications reached the publication remains unclear. Two days later, the Jewish Journal amplified those allegations, urging Gov. Gavin Newsom to consider them as he weighed California Assembly Bill (AB) 2551, CFA-sponsored legislation challenging campus protest restrictions imposed after the 2024 Palestine solidarity encampments. Less than a week after The Free Press story was published, Newsom vetoed the bill.

Pro-Israel and Jewish advocacy organizations had already campaigned against AB 2551 before the union’s internal deliberations were targeted, arguing that greater scrutiny would weaken rules needed to protect Jewish students from harassment and intimidation. Newsom’s veto does not prove coordination, but the campaign portraying CFA as hostile to Jewish students had become entangled with the union’s fight against campus protest restrictions.

The CSU’s systemwide policy prohibits encampments, overnight demonstrations, and unauthorized structures. The CSU Academic Senate immediately condemned the restrictions as undermining academic freedom when it was instituted in 2024, while CFA warned that vague definitions of disruption threatened constitutionally protected speech, assembly, protest, and future strike activity. A major 2026 ACLU-Amnesty study, investigating 80 campuses over two years, documented sweeping repression of Palestine solidarity protests. As the report found, universities “have imposed sweeping restrictions on student speech, initiated disciplinary actions against students, and imposed severe punishments, including expulsions and suspensions.” The ACLU has insisted that even legitimate time, place, and manner restrictions “must leave ample room for students to express themselves.”

The controversy reaches beyond CFA and CSU. Unions and rank-and-file organizations committed to Palestine solidarity have been forced to relitigate, again and again, whether anti-Zionism and solidarity with Palestinians constitute antisemitism — and whether such organizing should be systematically policed, investigated, or surveilled. At stake is a more fundamental right of the exploited: Can workers democratically connect economic struggles with Palestine solidarity, resistance to anti-immigrant and anti-Black racism, and the defense of civil liberties without exposing their organizing and deliberations to external pressure or repression?

We already have a word for the use of legal process as a political weapon: lawfare. You do not necessarily have to win. Investigation, expense, compelled disclosure, and possible sanctions can exact their own price.

Call its media counterpart pressfare: leaked material, selective or doctored quotations, and public identification can turn people into political targets and invite pressure on employers, universities, or government agencies.

The leaked CFA meeting should not be adjudicated through fragments selected for publication, especially when CFA’s statewide record contradicts the portrayal of a union indifferent to antisemitism. During the 2024 encampments, CFA opposed antisemitism and Islamophobia “in all forms” while supporting the encampments. Amid a 2025 federal antisemitism investigation, it stated that “as CFA members, we are united against antisemitism; it has no place in our communities,” while defending members’ academic freedom. CFA’s Palestine, Arab, and Muslim Caucus likewise defines its mission as confronting racism “in all its manifestations,” explicitly including antisemitism. The Free Press story — a clear example of pressfare — sought to overwrite this legacy with weaponized accusations, undermining the trust that workers place in the sanctity of their union spaces and processes.

Antisemitism demands to be taken seriously — which is why accusations of anti-Jewish discrimination should not be instrumentalized. Kenneth Stern, director of the Bard Center for the Study of Hate, has …

title: ABD'den müttefiklerine İran uyarısı: Seçim sonrası saldırı gündemde
content:
ABD yönetimi, Orta Doğu’daki müttefiklerini İran’a yönelik yeni askeri saldırı olasılığına ve Tahran’ın verebileceği karşılığa karşı hazırlıklı olmaları konusunda uyardı. Associated Press’in (AP) haberine göre Washington, yeni saldırıların 3 Kasım’da yapılacak ABD ara seçimlerinin ardından gündeme gelebileceğini bölge ülkelerine iletti.

Konuyla ilgili bilgi sahibi iki ABD’li diplomat, Başkan Donald Trump’ın İran’a yeniden saldırı düzenlenmesi konusunda henüz nihai kararını vermediğini belirtti. İsimlerinin açıklanmasını istemeyen diplomatlara göre ABD, olası saldırıların birkaç gün sürebileceği uyarısında bulundu.

Washington’ın müttefiklerinden, İran’ın misilleme kapsamında enerji tesislerini ve diğer kritik altyapıyı hedef alabileceği ihtimaline karşı önlem almalarını istediği aktarıldı. Trump’ın saldırı tehditleri ve ABD’nin bölge ülkelerine yaptığı uyarılar, Orta Doğu’da çatışmaların yeniden genişleme riski taşıdığı yönündeki endişeleri artırdı.

ABD’nin saldırı ihtimaline ilişkin uyarıları, bölgedeki askeri hareketliliğin arttığı bir dönemde geldi. Pentagon, eylül ayının sonunda uçak gemisi USS Theodore Roosevelt ile deniz piyadelerini taşıyan amfibi çıkarma gemilerini San Diego’dan Basra Körfezi’ne sevk etti. AP’nin aktardığına göre sevkiyat yaklaşık 9 bin askeri kapsıyor.

ABD’li bir yetkili, bu sevkiyatın ardından bölgede 20 binden fazla denizci ve deniz piyadesi ile yüzlerce hava aracının konuşlandırılabileceğini belirtmişti. ABD Donanması, nisan ayında 2003’ten bu yana ilk kez Orta Doğu’da aynı anda üç uçak gemisi bulundurmuştu.

Wall Street Journal da daha önce Körfez ülkelerinin İran’la olası bir askeri tırmanışa karşı hazırlıklı olmaları konusunda bilgilendirildiğini bildirmişti.

ABD’nin bölgedeki askeri varlığını artırması, Trump yönetiminin diplomatik seçenekleri tamamen dışlamadığı açıklamalarına karşın yeni bir saldırı olasılığını gündemde tutuyor.

İran’la savaşın ekonomik sonuçları, ABD’deki ara seçimler öncesinde Cumhuriyetçi adaylar üzerindeki baskıyı artırıyor. Saldırılar ve bölgedeki çatışmalar nedeniyle yükselen akaryakıt fiyatları, taşımacılıktan sanayiye kadar birçok alanda maliyetleri artırdı.

Trump, son haftalarda Cumhuriyetçi adayların seçim kampanyalarına ağırlık verirken İran’a yönelik yeni adımlar konusunda net bir takvim açıklamadı.

AP’nin haberinde, ABD’nin İran’a karşı yürüttüğü savaşın maliyetinin de arttığına dikkat çekildi. Pentagon’un Kongre’ye sunduğu son tahmine göre savaşın ABD bütçesine maliyeti 47,1 milyar dolara ulaştı.

İran Dışişleri Bakanı Abbas Arakçi, çarşamba günü yaptığı açıklamada Tahran’ın diplomasiye şans vermeyi sürdürdüğünü bildirdi. Arakçi, İran’ın daha önce sunduğu ve ateşkese dönüş için temel alınmasını istediği öneri üzerindeki görüşmelerin arabulucular aracılığıyla sürdüğünü belirtti.

Birleşik Arap Emirlikleri Dışişleri Bakanlığı da taraflara gerilimin düşürülmesi ve siyasi çözüm yollarının izlenmesi çağrısında bulundu.

author: Jake Johnson
title: Cost of Iran War Jumps to $47 Billion — a Figure Believed to Be an Underestimate
content:
“It can be over whenever I want it to be over,” Trump said of the historically unpopular war during a rally in Texas.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

US President Donald Trump told a crowd of his supporters on Tuesday that his illegal war of choice in Iran will end “whenever I want it to” as the conflict’s official price tag reportedly jumped to $47 billion — a figure that independent analysts believe to be a dramatic underestimate.

“It can be over whenever I want it to be over,” Trump said of the historically unpopular war during a rally in Texas, a week before the midterm elections. “But we have to have it end properly, with… a total statement [that] they will never have a nuclear weapon.” (Iran has already said repeatedly that it would never develop nuclear weapons, including in the opening pages of the Obama-era agreement that Trump shredded during his first White House term.)

Trump’s remarks came as The Hill reported that the federal government’s official estimate of the Iran war’s cost has jumped $3 billion since last month, rising to $47 billion.

“The biggest chunk of the cost is munition replacement at $29 billion,” The Hill reported, citing a US Central Command estimate that the outlet obtained on Tuesday. “Nearly $12 billion is obligated for incremental costs of military action and another $6.1 billion to replace equipment losses, according to the estimate. Air Force’s support for deployed personnel, airlift, base, communication support, and transportation in theater costs $7.6 billion. The estimate does not include the cost to damaged US military bases in the Middle East.”

When such damage — which has been far more extensive than the Pentagon has acknowledged publicly — and other factors are included, the price tag balloons. Stephen Semler, a senior fellow at the Center for International Policy, estimated in July that the US spent more than $103 billion in the first four months of the war, which has killed thousands of people and sent gas prices soaring.

In the US, consumers have spent an extra $146 billion on gasoline and diesel since the war’s beginning in February, according to a running tracker maintained by the Watson School of International and Public Affairs at Brown University.

Trump said Tuesday that the unauthorized war’s end would come “very quick,” despite evidence that his administration is preparing for yet another round of heavy bombings in Iran after the midterm elections.

“The US has told several Gulf Arab countries to be prepared for a short, intense military campaign after the US midterm elections,” the Wall Street Journal reported late Tuesday, citing unnamed people briefed on the conversations. “The communications through diplomatic and military channels are among a growing number of indications that the US and Israel are readying to launch a new round of heavy combat operations against Iran, risking a major escalation in hopes of degrading Tehran’s strength and pushing it toward negotiations.”

“US forces in the region have been restocking their munitions, and bomber aircraft and jet fighters are preparing for strikes,” the Journal added. “An additional aircraft carrier strike group and Marine expeditionary unit are also poised to join an armada of roughly 20 other warships operating in the Middle East next month, although some ships could rotate out.”

Truthout is funded almost entirely by readers — that’s why we can speak truth to power and cut against the mainstream narrative. But independent journalists at Truthout face mounting political repression under Trump.

title: ABD ara seçimleri: Yenilgiye yürüyen Trump, Kongre'yle savaşa hazırlanıyor
content:
ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, 24 Ekim'de Georgia eyaletinde düzenlenen Cumhuriyetçi Parti seçim mitinginde İran savaşının Amerikan petrol şirketlerine nasıl büyük paralar kazandırdığından söz ederken danışmanlarının, bu konulara girmemesi için kendisini uyardığını anlattı.


Danışmanları, Başkana, halk benzin istasyonlarında durmadan yükselen fiyatlarla boğuşurken petrol şirketlerinin kazancıyla övünmesinin tepki çekeceğini hatırlatmıştı. Trump, bunlara hiç aldırmadan konuşmayı sürdüreceğini söyledi:


“Zerre kadar umurumda değil. Söyleyeceğim. Deli gibi servet kazanıyoruz." 


Trump, yükselen petrol fiyatları sayesinde ABD'nin zenginleştiğini savundu; fiyatların yakında düşeceğini vaat etti. Ancak Trump'ın petrol şirketleri açısından kazanç saydığı gelişme, milyonlarca Amerikalı için geçim sıkıntısının başlıca nedenlerinden biri olmaya devam ediyor ve pompada benzin fiyatı düşmüyor.


Amerikan Otomobil Birliğinin (AAA) 28 Ekim verilerine göre benzinin litresi ortalama 1,12 dolar. İran savaşından önce yüzde 40 daha düşüktü. Dizelin litresi ise 1,68 dolara ulaştı. Bu fiyatlar muazzam vergi yüküyle oluşan Türkiye'deki karşılıklarının altındaysa da, iki yakasını bir araya getirmekte zorlanan ABD tüketicileri açısından giderleri üzerine binen katlanılmaz bir yük halini alıyor. 


Yüksek akaryakıt fiyatları yalnızca otomobil sahiplerinin ulaşım masraflarını değil, nakliyeyi, tarımsal üretimi ve tüketim mallarının fiyatlarını da etkiliyor.


Demokratlar anketlerde önde, Kongre'nin geleceği belirsiz


Gelecek hafta, 3 Kasım Salı günü Temsilciler Meclisi'nin 435 sandalyesinin tamamı ve Senato'daki 35 sandalye için seçim yapılacak. Cumhuriyetçiler her iki meclisteki çoğunluklarını korumaya, Demokratlar ise Trump yönetimi üzerinde etkili bir Kongre denetimi kurmaya çalışıyor.


26 Ekim'de tamamlanan Reuters/Ipsos araştırmasında Trump'ın görevini onaylayanların oranı yüzde 32. Kayıtlı seçmenlerin yüzde 47'si Demokrat, yüzde 36'sı Cumhuriyetçi Kongre adaylarına oy vereceğini belirtiyor.


Ancak ülke çapındaki toplam oy üstünlüğü doğrudan Kongre'ye gönderilecek temsilci çoğunluğuna denk gelmiyor. ABD Temsilciler Meclisi'ne gidecek üyeler seçim bölgelerinin sınırlarına bağlı, her seçim bölgesi aynı sayıda seçmen barındırmıyor. Senatoda ise yalnızca belirli eyaletlerde seçim yapılması sonuçlar üzerinde belirleyici olabiliyor. 


Cumhuriyetçiler halen 100 üyeli Senato'da 53'e karşı 47 ile çoğunlukta. Demokratların bu mecliste çoğunluğu ele geçirmesi için net 4 sandalye daha kazanması gerekiyor.


Partiler özellikle Maine, Kuzey Carolina, Ohio, Iowa ve Teksas gibi kritik eyaletlerde yoğun kampanyalar yürütüyor. Seçim gözlemcileri, Temsilciler Meclisi'nde Demokratların kazanımlar elde edebileceği bir ortamın varlığından söz ederken Senato yarışlarının sonucuna ilişkin belirsizlik sürüyor.


İran savaşının 47 milyar dolarlık faturası


Cumhuriyetçilerin karşı karşıya olduğu en önemli sorunlardan başında, ABD ve İsrail'in 28 Şubat'ta İran'a saldırmasıyla başlayan savaşın ekonomik ve siyasi sonuçları geliyor. 


Reuters'ın 28 Ekim'de açıkladığı Pentagon hesaplarına göre savaşın doğrudan askerî maliyeti 47 milyar doları aştı. Bunun 29 milyar dolarından fazlası, kullanılan mühimmatın yenilenmesi ve 6 milyar dolardan fazlası, kaybedilen veya hasar gören askerî araçların yerine konması için gerekli. 


Bu hesaba savaşın küresel enerji piyasalarında yol açtığı fiyat artışları dahil değil.


Nisanda varılan ateşkes, kalıcı bir barış anlaşmasına dönüşmedi. ABD'nin İran'a uyguladığı deniz ablukası sürerken, Trump yönetimi yeni bir askerî operasyon olasılığını da gündemde tutuyor.


Trump, 8 Ekim'de, seçimlerden önce yeni bir saldırı düzenlemeyeceğini açıklamıştı. Ancak 28 Ekim'de bu seçim sonrasında İran'a yeniden saldırılıp saldırılmayacağı sorulduğunda “Her şey mümkün” yanıtını verdi.


Bu koşullar altında ABD seçmenleri, süre giden savaşın sonuçlanmadığı ve yeniden tırmanma olasılığının ortadan kalkmadığı bir dönemde sandığa gidiyor olacak.


ABD Çalışma İstatistikleri Bürosuna göre eylülde yıllık tüketici enflasyonu yüzde 3,7'ye ulaştı. Enerji fiyatları bir yıl içinde yüzde 20,4, benzin fiyatları ise yüzde 34,2 arttı.


İran savaşı böylece dış politika tartışmalarını aşarak Amerikalı ailelerinin günlük harcamalarına ve seçim tercihlerine doğrudan yansıyor.


Rusya'yla uzlaşmanın arkasındaki enerji hesabı


İran savaşının enerji piyasalarına etkisi, Trump'ın Ukrayna savaşına ilişkin girişimlerinde de hissediliyor.

title: ICE Is Running One of the Largest Anti-Left Surveillance Operations in US History (Wired)
content:
ICE’s Homeland Security Investigations is engaged in far-reaching spying against left-wing activists that rivals the FBI and CIA crackdowns on the Civil Rights and anti-war movements.

Attorneys for 15 Minnesota residents facing federal conspiracy charges have obtained evidence of a sweeping, possibly unconstitutional spying operation carried out by Immigration and Customs Enforcement against left-wing social movements in Minnesota and beyond.

The high-profile Minnesota 15 prosecution makes clear that the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), flush with federal funds and newly hired personnel, is now President Donald Trump’s primary tool against dissent, with a powerful array of post-9/11 investigative authorities brought to bear against everyday Americans organizing their communities.

Nothing of this scale has been seen in the United States, experts say, since the federal government’s counterinsurgency against the New Left and the anti-war movement in the 1960s and 1970s.

Among the records revealed during the discovery process in these cases are dozens of reports, audio transcripts, emails, intercepted Signal chats, photographs, database queries, and more. They reveal the inner workings of the domestic terrorism investigations, running under the names Project Whipple Shield and Operation Puppet Master, authorized by the controversial National Security Presidential Memorandum 7.

Published following Charlie Kirk’s assassination in September of last year, NSPM 7 instructs federal law enforcement to use every tool available against organizations and people who criticize the administration’s policies and espouse “anti-Christian” ideas. The full scope and extent of the investigations it authorizes remains unknown.

Defense attorneys for the Minnesota 15 claim that the prosecution stems from a broader nationwide surveillance operation aimed at opponents of the Trump administration’s immigration policies. One attorney in the case directly compares the DHS-run campaign to the FBI’s infamous Counterintelligence Program, or COINTELPRO, which unconstitutionally surveilled, infiltrated, and blackmailed racial justice, civil rights, and anti-war movements from the 1950s through the early 1970s.

Three former law enforcement officials who reviewed filings concur, telling WIRED that the case is almost certainly part of a wider intelligence-gathering operation that began long before the administration invaded Minnesota in December 2025.

Dueling motions in the case over discovery of DHS’s surveillance program reveal that personnel with Homeland Security Investigations—one of ICE’s two components—repurposed funding mechanisms and investigative tools for serious criminal probes and turned them on domestic dissenters. Operation Keyhole, the HSI undercover program that bankrolled the Minnesota 15 prosecution, dates back to 2008. As of June 2026, it was underwriting a half dozen active undercover investigations in the Minneapolis–Saint Paul area.

Around 120 HSI agents, many drawn from specialized units across the country that have served as the leading edge of the administration’s militarized immigration enforcement operations, were assigned to the case—including 11 undercovers. They used highly invasive surveillance techniques, including the deployment of Reaper drones and Patriot Act tools usually restricted to money laundering and terrorism investigations. Undercover operatives also infiltrated churches in apparent violation of a court order.

The Minnesota 15 indictment stems from the Trump administration’s demand that the Justice Department “go big and go loud” to crack down on community response networks during last winter’s Operation Metro Surge. Twin Cities activists organized volunteers to monitor DHS agents and their vehicles using encrypted Signal groups, homebuilt vehicle databases, and a centralized dispatch system. Government prosecutors claim that this amounts to a criminal conspiracy to block immigration enforcement, unlawfully identify and stalk federal agents, and even assault them.

Their defense attorneys say the heavy charges filed against the Minnesota 15 don’t align with their alleged conduct. “This is the first time I’ve had a client who’s accused of a conspiracy and went on a speaking tour,” says Kevin Riach, who represents defendant Isaac Sant.

title: The AKP cannot function without war
content:
It is becoming increasingly clear with each passing day that the process initiated by Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan through his February 27, 2025 Call for Peace and Democratic Society amounts, in a sense, to a disruption of the established game. To the domestic and international powers that divided Kurdistan into four parts, imposed genocide on the Kurds, and have benefited from the Kurdish question and the contradictions and conflicts it has generated, the message was effectively: “I will not play the game you want and impose on me. I will play my own game.” In this way, Öcalan has challenged the politics of war and moved toward adopting a politics of peace.


This new strategy and policy developed by Abdullah Öcalan has undoubtedly shocked and bewildered the forces that have tied themselves to, and benefited from, the strategy of conflict arising from the Kurdish question. It appears that the AKP is among those most taken aback. Indeed, under present conditions, when Turkey’s interests and democratic future lie in a politics of peace, the AKP remains unable to break away from its entrenched politics of war and militarization. It has failed to respond positively as required to the peace process initiated by Öcalan. The steadily increasing violence, judicial repression, and police pressure across all areas of life in Kurdistan and Turkey are manifestations of this. By sending military equipment to Saudi Arabia for use against the Houthis in Yemen, preparing to deploy troops, and developing new military alliances in the region, the AKP demonstrates that it cannot function without war and is unable to abandon its politics of war.


As of October 29, the Republic of Turkey will have completed its 103rd year since its founding and will be entering its 104th year. If the period that began with the fascist military coup of September 12, 1980, is to be defined as the “Second Republic,” then the AKP’s quarter-century in power undoubtedly constitutes the central ruling force of this period. It could also be put this way: The “Second Republic” process initiated by the military junta headed by Kenan Evren found its true ruling power under Tayyip Erdoğan’s leadership. In other words, the “Second Republic” was shaped by the mentality of Kenan Evren and Tayyip Erdoğan. Its only difference from the First Republic was the incorporation of political Islam, which had previously been excluded from the state under the label of “reactionism,” into the state apparatus. Thus, the “Second Republic” continued and intensified its hostility toward the Kurds and communism.


Let us look back and recall this recent history. The Evren–Özal alliance, which laid the foundations of the September 12 regime, became the driving force behind this transformation of the Republic. It was primarily Turgut Özal who carried this forward, developing the political line inherited from Menderes and Demirel, albeit with cautious and hesitant steps. When the same Turgut Özal sought to pursue a similar approach toward the Kurds, however, that intention cost him his life. Necmettin Erbakan attempted to advance the process initiated by the Evren–Özal alliance, but his approach to the Kurdish question was also deemed unacceptable, and he was pushed aside. Having drawn the necessary lessons from all these developments, Tayyip Erdoğan became the most skillful and thorough practitioner of the mentality and policies of September 12.


Tayyip Erdoğan’s nearly quarter-century in power should also be examined in two distinct periods. During the first period, when he was still engaged in a fierce power struggle with the secularist forces of the Republic, he was compelled to forge both covert and overt alliances to consolidate his strength. To succeed in this struggle, he pursued a policy of presenting himself as generally “pro-peace.” Indeed, during this period, whenever elections approached, he requested a ceasefire from the PKK and secured electoral victories by ensuring that elections were held in an atmosphere of ceasefire. In the second period, after neutralizing the secularist forces within the Republic, he fully aligned himself with the Turkish Republic’s deeply entrenched anti-Kurdish and militaristic policies. He donned a military uniform and sought to fulfill the role of commander-in-chief. During this period, he undoubtedly adopted a strategy of winning elections by escalating both domestic and external conflicts.

title: Nobel Peace Laureate Navi Pillay on ICC, Gaza, Rape as War Crime, Her South African Roots & Mandela
content:
We speak with the acclaimed South African human rights lawyer and international jurist Navi Pillay, who was awarded this year’s Nobel Peace Prize. Pillay has been the United Nations high commissioner for human rights and a judge at both the International Criminal Court and at an international tribunal investigating the 1994 genocide in Rwanda. Most recently, she led the U.N. Independent International Commission of Inquiry that concluded Israel had committed genocide in Gaza. Hours after Pillay was announced as winner of the Nobel Prize, the United States imposed sweeping new sanctions against the International Criminal Court.


“It’s extremely shocking to me, totally unacceptable, that the United States administration can today impose sanctions against the International Criminal Court,” says Pillay, speaking to

Democracy Now!

 from The Hague.


Navi Pillay is now 85 years old. She was born into an Indian Tamil family in apartheid South Africa in 1941. The first woman to start a law practice in Natal, South Africa, in 1967, Pillay began her legal career defending anti-apartheid activists including Nelson Mandela, exposing torture, and helping establish key rights for prisoners on Robben Island. Mandela, as president, later appointed Pillay to the High Court of South Africa, making her the first woman of color on that bench.

author: cnt.es
title: ¡Guerra a la Guerra!
content:
Días de movilización en todo el globo. Trabajadores y trabajadoras de todo el mundo no ocultan su descontento con la situación. Salarios que no se mantienen a la par que los precios. Servicios públicos degradados por falta de inversión. Estudiantes, trabajadores y trabajadoras o pensionistas han salido a las calles en Italia, Francia, España… La respuesta de políticos y gobiernos ha sido la misma en todos los casos: no hay dinero para pagar las pensiones, la educación, la sanidad, etc. Sin embargo, en muchas ocasiones han acordado hace poco aumentar la parte del presupuesto destinada a gastos militares. Parece que es una cuestión de prioridades. Prefieren comprar otro misil, antes que una cama de hospital.


Esto por sí solo bastaría para oponerse a la guerra y al gasto militar, pero hay muchas más razones. En primer lugar, no es cierto que estemos en el mismo barco en un país cualquiera contra un enemigo común, sea cual sea este. Los y las jóvenes de clase trabajadora servirán de carne de cañón en todos los conflictos, mientras que los ricos encontrarán la manera de mantenerse al margen o incluso de sacar provecho de ello. Sin embargo, la difícil situación de la clase trabajadora es muy similar en cualquier lado de una frontera. Algunos políticos no dejan de hablar de la patria y nación, pero guardan un conveniente silencio sobre el hecho de que los empresarios y la clase obrera pueden proceder del mismo país, pero sus objetivos son opuestos. Como dice el lema: «Ni guerra entre pueblos ni paz entre clases».


En segundo lugar, no prestes atención a nadie que se llene la boca con la defensa del interés de un país a costa de otro o mediante el poderío de su ejército. La historia nos enseña que, en la mayoría de los casos, esta retórica solo conduce al conflicto armado y al desastre. Incluso para el bando vencedor. ¿De qué sirve ganar una guerra a costa de la muerte de millones de jóvenes? Suele ser la extrema derecha la que incide en este tipo de discurso, pero hay que tener en cuenta que, si estalla una guerra, nadie gana y el discurso de la disuasión y el gasto militar solo conduce al desastre.


Por último, la guerra es un infierno. Punto. Debe evitarse a toda costa.


Como organización internacional, que promueve el anarcosindicalismo y el sindicalismo revolucionario, CIT busca fomentar la organización de la clase trabajadora de todo el mundo y la defensa de sus derechos e intereses, en lugar de la lucha fratricida entre iguales. Por eso, CIT acordó y ratificó en su último congreso una jornada de acción contra la guerra el 30 de octubre, y por eso nuestras secciones llevan ya bastante tiempo planificando huelgas, manifestaciones y piquetes para ese día, cada una según sus posibilidades. Estas acciones van desde una huelga general en Italia (más información en el siguiente enlace, en italiano:

https://usi-cit.org/

) hasta una serie de concentraciones y actos en otros lugares. Ahora más que nunca: ¡guerra a la guerra!

author: L214
title: Enquête abattoir Cooperl
content:
L214 publie une enquête sur l’étourdissement des cochons au CO₂ dans l’un des plus gros abattoirs de France : l’abattoir Cooperl de Montfort-sur-Meu, en Ille-et-Vilaine (Bretagne).

Les images, commentées par l'écrivaine Marie Darrieussecq, montrent la cruauté de cette méthode d'étourdissement dont les instances scientifiques ont établi qu’elle est source de peur, de détresse et de souffrance.

Plus de trente vétérinaires signent un appel publié ce jour pour demander l’interdiction du gazage au CO₂ des cochons. L214 se joint à cette demande et entame un recours contre l’État pour faire interdire cette pratique. L’enseigne de supermarchés Carrefour fait fabriquer par son partenaire Cooperl ses produits à base de viande de porc sous ses marques distributeurs, notamment sa marque Filière Qualité Carrefour. L’association demande à Carrefour de refuser le gazage des cochons et de signer le Plant Protein Pact.

Le musicien Moby apporte son soutien et appelle à signer la pétition.

Chaque heure d’abattage, plus de 800 cochons sont gazés au CO₂ à l’abattoir Cooperl de Montfort-sur-Meu, en Bretagne. Plongés dans une fosse à haute concentration en CO₂, les cochons ont la sensation de se noyer : ils hurlent, paniquent, cherchent désespérément à fuir. Il leur faut entre 21 et 60 secondes pour perdre conscience…

Ce n’est ni instantané, ni sans souffrance. Les instances scientifiques européenne (EFSA) et britannique (AWC) l’affirment depuis 20 ans : cette méthode provoque douleur, peur et détresse respiratoire. Le Royaume-Uni envisage même d’y renoncer, et plus de trente vétérinaires demandent son interdiction.

Pourtant, l’abattoir Cooperl de Montfort-sur-Meu a investi en 2024 environ 5 millions d'euros dans cet équipement qui permet d’abattre un nombre gigantesque d’animaux, de conquérir de nouveaux marchés, d’augmenter les cadences et la productivité. L’enseigne Carrefour fait fabriquer par son partenaire Cooperl des produits à base de cochons gazés sous ses marques, dont la Filière Qualité Carrefour, tout en se disant « pionnier sur le bien-être animal »…

À l’État français : interdire le gazage au CO₂ des cochons ;

À Carrefour : ne plus s’approvisionner en produits issus de cochons gazés et participer à un changement collectif en s'engageant dans le Plant Protein Pact, pour prendre part à une réduction de moitié du nombre d’animaux tués d’ici 2030.

Plus nous serons nombreux et nombreuses, plus il sera difficile pour les responsables de fermer les yeux. Signez et partagez : les cochons ne peuvent pas parler pour eux-mêmes, mais nous, oui.

title: QUORN HUNT TRAINING HOUNDS TO KILL: WRITE TO YOUR MP
content:
The Hunt Saboteurs Association is asking our supporters to contact their MPs following the release of horrific drone footage involving the Quorn Hunt in Leicestershire.


Members of the Quorn Hunt use the fox’s body to encourage hounds to tear it apart.

Image: Northants Hunt Saboteurs


On Friday 16 October 2026, Northants Hunt Saboteurs filmed an incident near Kirby Bellars in which a fox was killed by hounds during a Quorn Hunt cubbing meet.


Hounds converge on the fox as hunt staff look on. Image:

Northants Hunt Saboteurs


The footage shows hounds seizing and tearing at the fox while hunt staff intervene to repeatedly encourage the hounds to attack. A hunting horn can be seen being blown over the hounds to reinforce the association between the horn call and the kill!


Take action: Contact your MP


Don’t let this disturbing footage go unnoticed.


Write to your MP, ask them to watch the video and to support robust legislation to strengthen the Hunting Act. 


Template letter below:


Organised Hunts hunting as usual – Famous Quorn Hunt filmed killing a fox


Dear [MP]


The 1st November will see the official start of the foxhunting season, but hunts have been out since August training their hounds to hunt and kill. This is called autumn hunting by them and cub hunting by the rest of us. 


This is illustrated by the film we obtained taken from a drone showing the Quorn Hunt killing a fox. This is ‘trail hunting’ in its bloody reality, and it happened just a few days ago, on the eve of the BHSA’s National Trail Hunting Day.


The full video can be viewed here:

https://www.huntsabs.org.uk/smokescreen-saturday-exposed/


Cub hunting is not some isolated activity. It is the preparation for the hunting season ahead. Throughout the autumn, young hounds are taught what to chase, what to kill and how to respond to the huntsman’s commands. What they learn – or fail to learn – during these crucial weeks sets the tone for the entire season.


This is what makes the Quorn Hunt footage so damning. It shows hounds being deliberately encouraged to seize and tear at a fox, with hunt staff repeatedly intervening to reinforce that behaviour.


As the British Hound Sports Association (BHSA) and the Countryside Alliance prepared to showcase so-called ‘trail hunting’ on National Trail Hunting Day – aka Smokescreen Saturday – the Quorn Hunt provided a horrifying glimpse of the reality behind the myth of trail laying.


The BHSA and defenders of so-called trail hunting want the public to believe the same hounds will spend the season following scent trails. Yet here they are, being trained on foxes, and of course, killing to the delight of the hunters.


The footage strikes at the very heart of the trail hunting smokescreen.


We need parliament to finish the consultation and push through a real hunting ban in the next parliament term as promised in the manifesto.


Regards


[Name]


[Address]
