title: Hêzil Özgür: Bêrîtan’s struggle is the story of the free woman
content:
YJAStar (Free Women’s Troops) guerrillas marked the 34th anniversary of the founding of the women’s army with a ceremony and cultural program in the mountains of Kurdistan. The event centered on the legacy of guerrilla commander Bêrîtan Hêvî (Gülnaz Karataş), who fell on October 25, 1992, during the Southern War. Her resistance against surrender and the attacks on the PKK at the time became a defining reference point in the development of an autonomous women’s military organization within the Kurdish freedom movement.


The event began with a speech by Hêzil Özgür from the YJA Star Central Headquarters. Other women guerrilla fighters reflected on Bêrîtan Hêvî’s significance for the women’s freedom movement and the development of a collective identity. The commemoration featured cultural performances and concluded with group dances.


“The women’s army was founded on Bêrîtan’s legacy”


Hêzil Özgür began by recalling the difficult years of 1991 and 1992, when the Kurdish freedom movement was experiencing growing support while simultaneously facing massive military attacks. Particularly large numbers of young women joined the guerrilla forces during this period, she noted. “In those years, participation increased across all sections of society, and the number of female comrades in particular grew significantly. The guerrilla’s influence in Kurdistan grew stronger by the day. At that time, young Kurds joined the struggle in groups from universities. Bêrîtan was also part of this generation.”


As a young guerrilla fighter, Özgür said, Bêrîtan Hêvî engaged deeply with the ideas of Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan and found in them a path toward her own liberation. “Her resistance during the fighting in 1992 ultimately marked the beginning of a new phase in women’s organizing. The women’s army was founded on the legacy of Comrade Bêrîtan. Leader Apo [Abdullah Öcalan] decided to establish it in response to Bêrîtan’s death,” Özgür said.


After running out of ammunition and having her weapon destroyed, Bêrîtan Hêvî refused to surrender to the opposing forces—the KDP Peshmerga, who were collaborating with the Turkish army—and jumped from a cliff. Within the Kurdish freedom movement, her actions have since been regarded as a symbol of resistance against surrender and betrayal.


“Bêrîtan began this novel, and other women continued writing it”


Hêzil Özgür placed Bêrîtan’s life story within the context of the Kurdish women’s movement’s development over several decades. Her political and personal legacy, she said, grew far beyond the struggles of that period. “Bêrîtan had never met Leader Apo in person, but her desire to meet him was very strong. She wanted to write his novel. Delving deeply into his philosophy and ideas and shaping her life around them held profound meaning for her.”


The history of Kurdish women, she said, has been shaped by resistance, a fighting spirit, and the pursuit of freedom. “With the development of the PKK, this tradition took on a new organized form. Today, through their struggle, Kurdish women have become a source of hope for women around the world. This is a great source of pride for us Kurdish women. Comrades like Bêrîtan are our guiding lights.”


Hêzil Özgür described the continuity between the different generations of the women’s freedom movement in particularly powerful terms: “All the fallen fighters of the women’s movement are a continuation of Bêrîtan’s novel and her political line. Bêrîtan began this novel, and the other comrades continued writing it. When we speak of Bêrîtan, we are also speaking of our own history—the history of free women.”


Evîn Bêrîtan: She embodies the spirit of the free woman


Guerrilla fighter Evîn Bêrîtan also described the anniversary, which coincides with the anniversary of Bêrîtan Hêvî’s death, as a significant point of reference for the entire women’s movement. “Bêrîtan’s stance and the founding of the women’s army hold symbolic significance for us women. They represent willpower, resistance, the path of the free woman, the refusal to submit to betrayal, and commitment to Leader Apo.”


The guerrilla fighter stated that YJA Star continued to follow this political and ideological foundation. Bêrîtan’s legacy, she said, has long since extended beyond the mountains of Kurdistan. “Bêrîtan represents the emergence of the women’s freedom movement. The anniversary of her death has become a symbol for all women. Her memory holds a special place in the mountains of …

author: Joe Mullin
title: French Court’s Site-Blocking Orders Drive Quad9 Out Of France
content:
A nonprofit service that protects internet users’ privacy is leaving France. Quad9, a free DNS resolver, has said

it will reluctantly stop serving users in France

 on November 24. This follows a French court order that Quad9 must block access to websites that are accused of infringing the copyrights of a sports broadcaster. Forcing a responsible privacy service out of an important market is a predictable result of trying to force infrastructure providers to be copyright police.


When you visit a website, a DNS resolver reads the domain name you type in—like

eff.org

— and translates it into a numerical IP address that’s used to direct data across the internet. A DNS resolver can see the names of websites you connect to, so its privacy policies are important. Quad9 is an NGO that’s incorporated in Switzerland, in part to protect its users from data demands. The company also helps protect users from malware and phishing by blocking domains that are known to be malicious. Services like Quad9 offer an alternative to the DNS resolvers of local internet service providers and wireless carriers, which are vulnerable to demands from law enforcement, censorship, and commercial surveillance.


In a blog post explaining its decision, Quad9 explains that the French court’s order forces it to make a decision that, either way, is bad for users. It could either “extend French law to the whole world (blocking globally)” or try to identify and block users only in France—something that it can’t do reliably, and a move that could leave the company facing massive fines if it fails to block websites perfectly within France. Quad9 says it is facing about 20 other lawsuits in France seeking similar blocking orders. 


Rather than accept these demands, Quad9 has decided to withdraw its service from France. That is a real loss for French users who rely on the service to protect their privacy and security. It is also the right thing to do, when faced with the alternative: making promises it can’t keep, or abandoning users’ rights worldwide. 


Quad9’s decision will not remove any allegedly infringing material from the internet. The organization doesn’t host websites. Users looking for particular websites can  easily

switch

 to another DNS resolver. So the material targeted by copyright holders will remain online and accessible, even while they drive a privacy-protecting service out of France. 


These events matter beyond the borders of France, and U.S. lawmakers should pay attention. Congress is considering multiple

site-blocking proposals

, which would require ISPs and other intermediaries, including DNS resolvers, to block access to websites in the name of protecting copyright. These bills threaten speech and our ability to access information online, and they are invitations to abuse. The Quad9 withdrawal shows another cost: if internet services get forced into being copyright cops, users can lose services that they rely on for privacy and security. 


Worse still, if neutral services like Quad9 are forced to build site-blocking systems for the benefit of copyright holders, it becomes far easier for other powerful interests, including repressive governments, to demand the same systems be used to censor speech they dislike, globally. 


Congress should reject site-blocking bills. They’re a threat to the open internet, and don’t help creators or creativity.

author: Alerta
title: Σχετικά με την συνεχή παρακολούθηση αναρχικού από την κρατική ασφάλεια στην Θεσσαλονίκη
content:
Σχετικά με την συνεχή παρακολούθηση αναρχικού από την κρατική ασφάλεια στην Θεσσαλονίκη


Αναδημοσιεύουμε το κείμενο που λάβαμε σχετικά με την συνεχή παρακολούθηση του αναρχικού Π.Λ. από την κρατική ασφάλεια στην Θεσσαλονίκη:


“Σχετικά με τη συνεχή παρακολούθησή μου από την κρατική ασφάλεια Θεσσαλονίκης


Μέσα από τη δημοσιοποίηση αυτού του κειμένου θα ήθελα να αναφερθώ στη στοχοποίησή μου από την κρατική ασφάλεια Θεσσαλονίκης εξαιτίας της δραστηριοποίησης μου στον αντιεξουσιαστικό/αναρχικό χώρο. Απόφαση που ελήφθη μετά από αρκετές ημέρες υπομονής και έπειτα από την κλιμακούμενη επίδειξη ισχύος.


Όλα αυτά τα χρόνια της πολιτικής μου παρουσίας στη Θεσσαλονίκη έχω δραστηριοποιηθεί σε συνελεύσεις της πόλης με ευρύτερες θεματικές, όπως ενάντια στην εκπαιδευτική αναδιάρθρωση, στα αντεργατικά νομοσχέδια, στις κρατικές δολοφονίες καθώς επίσης και σε πολλές συνελεύσεις επετειακών και αντιφασιστικών πορειών. Παράλληλα, οι πιέσεις που μου ασκούν οι διωκτικές αρχές θεωρώ πως αφορά και τη συμμετοχή μου στη συλλογικότητα Συμβούλιο Αναρχικών, η οποία την τελευταία περίοδο βρίσκεται στο επίκεντρο των κρατικών μηχανισμών.


Όλα ξεκινούν 6/9, μέρα με διαδηλώσεις ενάντια στην ομιλία του πρωθυπουργού στη ΔΕΘ. Μέρα που η πόλη της Θεσσαλονίκης γεμίζει με μπάτσους από όλη την Ελλάδα σε μια προσπάθεια αφενός να κάνουν επίδειξη ισχύος και αφετέρου να εκφοβίσουν άτομα μέσω προληπτικών προσαγωγών. Στη περίπτωση μου, βγαίνοντας από το σπίτι μου το μεσημέρι εκείνης της μέρας, με περικύκλωσαν ασφαλίτες ρωτώντας με αν είμαι ο Π.Λ. και αν έχω ταυτότητα μαζί μου. Μετά από κάποια λεπτά αναμονής πήραν την εντολή να με μεταφέρουν στη ΓΑΔΘ, όπου εκεί χρειάστηκε να βγάλω όλα μου τα ρούχα για να με ελέγξουν και να περιμένω 4 ώρες μέχρι να με αφήσουν.


Ακολουθεί ένα διάστημα σχεδόν 20 ημερών καθημερινής παρακολούθησης από τουλάχιστον 4 άνδρες της κρατικής ασφάλειας Θεσσαλονίκης. Στον καφέ, στα ψώνια, στο χώρο άθλησης, σε οποιαδήποτε διαδρομή κάνω με τη μηχανή μου, ακόμα και στον χώρο εργασίας μου. Αποκορύφωμα η χθεσινή στάση τους (24/10) όπου για πρώτη φορά έγιναν τόσο αντιληπτοί και προκλητικοί φτάνοντας σε σημείο ένας από αυτούς να μου κολλήσει με το μηχανάκι ενώ περίμενα σταματημένος στο φανάρι πάνω στη μηχανή μου.


Ο λόγος συγγραφής αυτού του κειμένου δεν είναι η θυματοποίηση μου αλλά η γνωστοποίηση αυτών των τακτικών ώστε οποιοσδήποτε αγωνιστής βρεθεί σε αντίστοιχη συνθήκη να γνωρίζει τις τακτικές των διωκτικών μηχανισμών. Άλλωστε οι προληπτικές προσαγωγές, οι φυσικές παρακολουθήσεις, η επιτήρηση με τη χρήση τεχνολογικών μέσων, η εισβολή σε σπίτια εντάσσονται στη βεντάλια της κρατικής καταστολής κατά τις οποίες ποτέ δε λογοδοτούν και δεν αναλαμβάνει ποτέ την ευθύνη κανείς από την ηγεσία της Ελληνικής Αστυνομίας. Ως στόχο έχουν την κάμψη των αντιστάσεων, τη δημιουργία κλίματος φόβου και τρομοκρατίας και την άσκηση ψυχολογικής πίεσης σε όσους/ες αγωνίζονται. Παράλληλα, δεν είναι λίγες οι φορές που οι μεθοδεύσεις τους κλιμακώνονται, για αυτό οτιδήποτε συμβεί σε εμένα και στους συντρόφους/συντρόφισσές μου τους καθιστώ υπεύθυνους. Δεν έχω σκοπό να σταματήσω την κινηματική δημόσια δράση που ανέφερα και παραπάνω, όση στοχοποίηση και αν δεχθώ.

Η ΤΡΟΜΟΚΡΑΤΙΑ ΔΕΝ ΘΑ ΠΕΡΑΣΕΙ

author: Mag
title: Wenn der Sparhaushalt in Frankreich auf den Alltag trifft, schließen sich BeamtInnen, Feuerwehrleute und SchülerInnen zusammen, erstmals am 29. September
content:
Dossier


„

200.000 Menschen demonstrierten am gestrigen Dienstag, de 29. September 2026 in ganz Frankreich – in insgesamt 115 Städten – auf Aufruf der Gewerkschaften hin (…) Gegenstand der Mobilisierung, zu denen alle relevanten Gewerkschaften aufgerufen hatten (mobilisiert hatte in Paris jedoch zu über 80 Prozent die CGT, hingegen die rechtssozialdemokratisch geführte CFDT nur einige Hundert Menschen, hinzu kamen andere Verbände wie die linksalterative Union syndicale Solidaires aber auch die betont rechte Polizeigewerkschaft Alliance, die am Schluss der Demo lief), war aber auch die in wenigen Tagen beginnende Haushaltsberatung für das Staatsbudget 2027. (…) Seit Wochenbeginn hat eine Protestbewegung der Oberschüler/innen (Lycéens und Lycéennes) eine erhebliche Schlagkaft angenommen. Auch auf der Pariser Demo wurde diese durch einen sehr dynamischen Jugendblock sichtbar

…“

Artikel von Bernard Schmid vom 30. September 2026

 („Es brennt sozial, aber die Feuerwehr ist da“) und im Dossier dazu

Aufrufe der Gewerkschaften und weitere Informationen


 sowie nun gesondert zu den

Protesten der SchülerInnen und Studierenden


 (samt gew. Unterstützung) gegen die Sparfolgen:


Es brennt sozial, aber die Feuerwehr ist da


200.000 Menschen demonstrierten am gestrigen Dienstag, de 29. September 2026 in ganz Frankreich – in insgesamt 115 Städten – auf Aufruf der Gewerkschaften hin, laut Angaben des französischen Innenministeriums, 300.000 waren es laut Zahlen des Gewerkschaftsdachverbands CGT, d.h. des linkeren der beiden stärksten Dachverbände (CGT und CFDT). In der Regel liegt auf rein quantitativer Ebene die Wahrheit irgendwo in der Mitte zwischen den beiden, jeweils „politischen“ Zahlen.


Koordiation der Oberschüler/innen Paris & banlieues rund um Paris bei der Demo am 6.10.2026 in Paris (Foto Bernard Schmid)


In der Hauptstadt Paris waren laut Polizei/Innenministerium „30.000“, lt. CGT jedoch „70.000“ Menschen auf dem Protestzug unterwegs. In diesem Falle scheint die rein quantitative Wahrheit wesentlich näher bei den Polizeizahlen zu liegen (Ehrlichkeit verpflichtet!). Das Vorbeiziehen an einem festen Punkt bspw. auf dem Boulevard Beuamarchais vor dem Eintreffen auf dem Bastille-Platz (auf circa halbem Wege) dauerte ziemlich genaue eine Stunde; in diesen Zeitraum und auf den vorhandenen Platz bekommt man keine 70.000 gepackt, es sei denn, man bindet sie ziemlich fest zusammen. Allerdings waren daneben auch protestierende und streikende Feuerwehrangehörige, lt. eigenen Angaben ihrer Gewerkschaften ihrer 10.000 und lt. Polizei ihrer 5.000, anderswo in der Stadt unterwegs und entzündeten im Süden von Paris Knaller.


Aufgerufen waren vor allem abhängig Beschäftigte in den öffentlichen Diensten – Lehranstalten, Krankenhäusern, aber auch Polizeibedienstete -, unter anderem aufgrund sinkender Reallöhne in den öffentlichen Diensten. Diese verloren lt. Zahlen der CGT, welche in diesem Falle inhaltlich ungleich glaubwürdiger sind als die aus Regierungskreisen und der bürgerlichen Presse (bei Teilnehmer/innen/zahlen mag dies bisweilen leicht anders ausfallen), seit dem Jahr 2000 insgesamt um -28,6 % bis -33 % an Kaufkraft, d.h. an Einkommen gemessen am durchschnittlichen Anstieg der Verdienste landesweit. (

https://www.cgt.fr/actualites/france/fonction-publique-elections/point-dindice-des-fonctionnaires-et-vous-combien-avez-vous-perdu


 und

https://www.20minutes.fr/politique/4247665-20260929-pourquoi-projet-budget-2027-fait-poches-fonctionnaires-emouvoir-personne

 

) Bereits seit drei Jahren werden seitens der öffentlichen Arbeitgeber ausschließlich Nullrunden bei den kollektiven Lohn- und Gehaltsverhandlungen hingelegt (vgl. auch

https://www.cgtetat.fr/vie-des-personnels/remunerations/evolution-du-pouvoir-d-achat/


). Allerdings behaupten ein öffentlich-rechtlicher Fernsehsender sowie das nationale Statistikamt INSEE, in den letzten zehn Jahren hätten Staatsbedienstete – wenn auch magere – um 1,2 % an Kaufkraft hinzugewonnen, Privatbeschäftigte hingegen um 3,2 %. (

https://www.franceinfo.fr/economie/greve/greve-des-fonctionnaires/fonctionnaires-en-greve-le-pouvoir-d-achat-des-agents-de-la-fonction-publique-a-t-il-reellement-baisse-ces-dernieres-annees_8215358.html

 

) Der kleine Trick dabei lautet, dass dabei alle Verdienstzuwächse etwa auch durch Stellenwechsel, Beförderungen, Altersprämien mit einberechnet sind und es sich nicht wirklich um Lohnerhöhungen handelt. Am übelsten dran sind in Frankreich oft die …

author: Rubén Morvolution
title: La clase no desaparece con sus viejas formas: respuesta a Alfredo Apilánez
content:
La clase no desaparece con sus viejas formas: respuesta a Alfredo Apilánez


Rubén Morvolution — Trabajador industrial


Quisiera comenzar agradeciendo a Alfredo Apilánez su respuesta a mi artículo

La huelga como medio, la clase como sujeto

 y, especialmente, el tono compañero con el que ha planteado nuestras diferencias. En tiempos en los que los debates políticos se convierten con demasiada facilidad en disputas entre posiciones cerradas, considero valioso poder discutir con rigor y respeto sobre cuestiones que nos preocupan y sobre las que compartimos, pese a nuestras discrepancias, un horizonte emancipador.


Creo que el desacuerdo fundamental se encuentra en la posibilidad de que la clase trabajadora vuelva a constituirse como sujeto colectivo de transformación social. Alfredo considera que las condiciones históricas que hicieron posible el movimiento obrero tradicional han desaparecido. Para sostenerlo señala la desindustrialización, la fragmentación laboral, la financiarización y la extensión de la sociedad de propietarios.


Buena parte de ese diagnóstico describe transformaciones reales del capitalismo. Sin embargo, conviene distinguir entre la desaparición de determinadas condiciones históricas y la imposibilidad de que surjan otras formas de organización y conciencia colectiva.


La desindustrialización de algunas economías occidentales no significa que la industria haya desaparecido. La producción industrial se ha reorganizado a escala mundial, desplazándose hacia otros territorios e integrándose en cadenas internacionales de producción, transporte y distribución. La clase trabajadora industrial no ha dejado de existir; su composición y distribución geográfica se han transformado. Y junto a ella se han desarrollado enormes sectores asalariados en la logística, los servicios, los cuidados y otras actividades fundamentales para el funcionamiento del capitalismo contemporáneo.


La fragmentación laboral, la financiarización y las contradicciones derivadas de la propiedad inmobiliaria constituyen obstáculos reales para la solidaridad de clase. No pretendo minimizarlos. Pero reconocer esas contradicciones no equivale a demostrar que sean históricamente insalvables.


Aquí considero necesario evitar cierta idealización retrospectiva del proletariado del siglo XX. Aquella clase trabajadora tampoco era homogénea ni estaba libre de contradicciones. Las diferencias de oficio, cualificación, salario, género, nacionalidad y situación laboral atravesaban profundamente el mundo del trabajo. También existían divisiones políticas, rivalidades sindicales y competencia entre trabajadores de distintos países.


La unidad obrera, allí donde llegó a desarrollarse, no fue consecuencia automática de compartir una posición en la producción. Fue una construcción histórica, resultado de conflictos, experiencias compartidas, solidaridad y organización. No podemos, por tanto, tomar una imagen idealizada del pasado como medida de las posibilidades del presente. Un análisis materialista debe partir de las contradicciones reales de cada época, no de una supuesta homogeneidad perdida.


Precisamente por eso hablo de

recomposición de clase

. No propongo reconstruir mecánicamente el movimiento obrero del siglo XX ni recuperar una identidad obrera inmutable. Tampoco sostengo que la dependencia del salario produzca automáticamente conciencia de clase o voluntad revolucionaria. La clase trabajadora existe como realidad social heterogénea, pero su constitución como sujeto político es una posibilidad histórica que depende de las luchas, las relaciones de solidaridad y las formas de organización que sea capaz de desarrollar.


Y tampoco se trata de afirmar el proletariado como fundamento permanente de una sociedad futura. Ya la

Primera Internacional, en sus Estatutos de 1864

, estableció que la emancipación de la clase trabajadora debía ser obra de ella misma y no perseguir nuevos privilegios, sino la abolición de toda dominación de clase. El horizonte comunista no consiste en perpetuar al proletariado, sino en superar el trabajo asalariado, la explotación y la propia división de la sociedad en clases.


La huelga, en este sentido, no representa para mí un fin ni una fórmula universal. Es una herramienta histórica de acción colectiva que permite intervenir sobre una relación material fundamental: la dependencia del capital respecto del trabajo. Su capacidad transformadora no está garantizada de antemano, del mismo modo que tampoco lo …

author: Elyas Mabchour
title: Morocco’s long game
content:
“A bad system will beat a good person every time.” The words of Dr. Deming, a pioneer of systems thinking, perfectly encapsulate the problems faced by Moroccan football throughout the 2000s. 

At the turn of the century, on paper, it seemed like Moroccan football was in a pretty good place. In 1998, it was ranked 13th globally by FIFA. The team’s performance at the 1986 World Cup, when Morocco became the first African and Arab country to advance to the knockout rounds, was monumental.

Despite these early successes, Morocco would subsequently not qualify for a World Cup for the next 20 years. By 2014, Moroccan football would hit rock bottom, with FIFA ranking it 81st in the world — a precipitous decline. 

But as many of us know, by 2022 Morocco had risen to the top of international football. The team defeated major World Cup players, such as Portugal and Spain, becoming the first African and Arab country to advance to the semifinals. 

To me, the answer to Morocco’s football transformation comes down to one thing: systems (and I think Dr. Deming would be happy with that conclusion).

The reason behind Morocco’s 2000s decline was simple: Morocco relied on a series of golden generations that emerged around the end of the 20th century. After

Morocco entered a World Bank Structural Adjustment Program to address the country’s debts in 1983

, key sources of state funding for local sport were cut off as the country recovered economically. Without an effective system for replacing players as they retired, the sport would naturally start to decline. 

Morocco’s rise after that initial decline was more complex. As I began exploring this story, I came across a turning point: the 2008 Skhirat Conference. Recognizing football’s unique position to drive national pride and social cohesion across a young demographic, the King took the rare step of intervening directly, calling for reforms in football governance and investment at all levels in what is now known as the

Royal Letter 2008

. The letter attributed the sport’s decline to corruption and mismanagement, as well as the decentralized nature of sports across the country. The King argued that Moroccan football’s problem was not talent, but the absence of a national system to develop it. 

The first and most consequential change was the appointment of Fouzi Lekjaa as president of the Royal Moroccan Football Federation (FRMF) in 2014. Despite Lekjaa’s middle-class origins, the Berkane native very quickly took to politics, developing his reputation as a shrewd and clever leader. Lekjaa spent years as Director of the Budget at the Ministry of Economy and Finance, while on the pitch, he served as president of RS Berkane, bringing crucial fiscal governance to state sports policy and guiding his club to a historic 2012 Botola Pro promotion. As FRMF president, Lekjaa stated that going forward,

Moroccan football would rely on a three-pronged approach: facilities, talent, and well-trained staff.


An early example of this approach was the opening of the Mohammed VI Football Academy in Salé in 2009 as a 140 million dirham ($14.4 million USD) project aimed at developing homegrown talent. In the following years, alumni such as Azzedine Ounahi and Youssef En-Nesyri would go on to represent Morocco at the 2022 World Cup, while many others joined the U17 and U20 teams.

The federation pushed clubs to strengthen their youth-development structures, creating more organized pathways to identify and train young players, while academy staff scouted talent nationwide. The academy’s first director, Nasser Larguet, would travel the country with his team, observing 15,000 young players and ultimately selecting 37 to come and train at the academy. This pipeline showed Morocco could grow talent at home, rather than relying solely on the diaspora. 

Yet, the diaspora remains a major source of talent for Moroccan football. The 2026 World Cup prompted headlines that

Morocco was the first team in World Cup history to feature a lineup of players who were all born outside of the country they represented

. But this headline reflects a longer-term strategy: with around 15% of all Moroccans living abroad, primarily in Europe, Morocco spent years building an extensive diaspora scouting and recruitment network.

The system would identify eligible talent at a young age, with coordinator Rabie Takassa saying that their network identifies talent as early as eight years old

. By leveraging both home-grown and …

author: Dominique Gené - Local Journalism Initiative Reporter
title: Kuujjuaq’s former elders’ home to be repurposed as homeless shelter
content:
Kuujjuaq’s shuttered elders’ home is set to become a temporary homeless shelter weeks after the facility’s former residents were

relocated

 to a long-term care home in Montreal.


A one-year agreement between the municipality, Nunavik Housing Bureau, Nunavik Regional Board of Health and Social Services and Ungava Tulattavik Health Center will allow the former Tusaajiapik Elders Home building to be used as a homeless shelter until October 2027, deputy Mayor Claude Gadbois said Friday in an interview.


The arrangement comes as the municipality looks for a permanent solution for people who experience homelessness.


Kuujjuaq’s previous homeless shelter closed in September because of its poor condition, including a leaking roof, mould in some areas and recurring leaks caused by problems such as frozen pipes, Gadbois said.


Those who used the shelter have been staying in tents set up behind the building.


“It’s been deteriorating for many years. We kept up with it, but it’s getting to the point where it’s not feasible anymore,” Gadbois said.


Meanwhile, Nunavik health officials announced in April there were technical issues with Tusaajiapik’s heating system and other “major technical components.” Another statement in September announced residents would be

moved

 to a facility in Pointe-Claire, Que., and that the home would close afterward.


Representatives with the Nunavik Housing Bureau, which owns the building, did not respond to questions about whether the heating issues has been fixed or if the building was suitable for use as a temporary homeless shelter.


Nunatsiaq News has also asked the health board and health centre for comment but did not immediately receive a response.


Gadbois said he did not believe the heating issues were the main reason for the facility’s closure.


“The issue is because there’s no sprinkler system. And the building does need renovation. But it’s suitable for us to use as our own shelter for that one year as an emergency measure,” he said.


Following a 2014 fire at an elder’s home in L’Isle Verte that killed 32 people, Quebec passed a law that required automatic sprinklers at all seniors’ homes that house 10 or more residents.


The deadline for facilities to be up to date was extended to December 2027. It’s unclear why the seniors were moved more than one year before this deadline.


Gadbois said the municipality is working to secure funding for a permanent shelter.


A proposal developed with the Quebec Housing Corp. four years ago would have provided funding for a nine-bed shelter, which the municipality considered too small.


“On any given day, we are between 15 and 25 people that need shelter,” Gadbois said, adding that this figure does not include people staying with relatives or couch surfing.


This means that number may be higher.


The municipality wants a 25-bed facility, potentially built on or near the existing shelter site once the old building is demolished.


“We can’t wait until October next year to make a plan,” Gadbois said.

title: Poll Challenges Narrative That Michigan Democratic Voters Are Split on El-Sayed
content:
Ninety-five percent of Democrats say they’re voting for El-Sayed, and just 4 percent say they’re voting for Rogers.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

In the final televised debate for Michigan’s Senate race, GOP candidate Mike Rogers used his closing remarks to claim that Jewish Democrats were supporting him because they view his Democratic opponent, Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, as “too extreme” on the subject of Israel.

“Jewish Democrats who are afraid for their children when their daughters can’t wear their Star of David walking across Michigan’s campus, these are real,” Rogers told the audience. “My opponent’s rhetoric, his vitriol, is having consequences.”

The idea that El-Sayed’s criticisms of Israel have alienated Jewish Democrats is certainly not limited to propaganda from the Rogers campaign. In recent weeks, multiple articles have used this very narrative as their thesis.

“Michigan Democrats at odds over Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed as November nears,” a Quartz headline declares.

“Questions about El-Sayed’s stance on Israel, accusations of antisemitism, and his campaign’s relationship with [left-wing Twitch streamer Hasan] Piker have kept the party’s attention away from its general-election opponent, Republican Mike Rogers,” insists the piece. “The divisions come as Michigan’s statehouse and governor’s races are also closely contested.”

Division was also the theme of an NPR piece claiming that Democrats were trying to “unify” before the midterms. The article asserts that “healing the fractures is proving complicated” and quotes multiple Democratic voters who express reservations about the candidate over Israel.

“Democrats are still struggling to unite behind El-Sayed after the primary exposed deep disagreements over Israel,” says PBS News.

CNN said a “ruptured” Democratic Party is “trying” to unite around the candidate.

The Detroit-based Super PAC TFM is attempting to ride this purported wave, spending nearly $6 million on ad campaigns connected to a “Democrats for Mike Rogers” effort.

​“We believe in the true spirit of the Democratic Party, always standing against hate and bigotry, no matter where it comes from, who it targets, or whether it is politically inconvenient or not,” reads the campaign’s website. “We believe every American deserves dignity, respect, and equal protection under the law.”

This past weekend, a planned “Democrats for Mike Rogers” rally in Pontiac, Michigan, drew almost no one.

The Bulwark’s Joe Perticone shared images of the event on Twitter, showing three people in an empty parking lot and one person operating a camera.

“When your astroturf campaign meets actual turf,” joked the liberal social media account MeidasTouch.

Source sends along photos of said “Democrats for Mike Rogers” rally, happening now… https://t.co/fWWnVnbXA8 pic.twitter.com/wxhlMWVQGU

The low turnout probably wasn’t a surprise to anyone who read a recent Marist survey of Michigan voters. Despite the media narrative detailing a massive split among Democratic voters, 95% of Democrats say they’re voting for El-Sayed, and just 4% say they’re voting for Rogers. 3% of Michigan Republicans actually say they’re voting for El-Sayed, but this minuscule number certainly hasn’t led to a host of stories about divisions within the GOP.

“The Democrats have a six-point advantage against the Republicans on the generic congressional ballot question among Michigan likely voters,” reads a write-up summarizing the poll’s findings. “That leads opens up to 10 points among registered voters, little changed from the nine-point lead the Democrats had in September. President Donald Trump’s approval rating is upside down in Michigan, and a plurality of likely voters express worry about their personal finances.”

If this is reality, why do many articles on the race tell the story of a divided party, and why do they rely primarily on testimony from rare voters to convey a wider trend?

Furthermore, why do so few of these pieces point out that Israel has grown deeply unpopular among Democratic voters and that El-Sayed’s positions are consistent with the vast majority of the base? An April 2026 Pew poll found that 80% of Democrats and Democratic-leaning independents held an unfavorable view of Israel, compared with 53% in 2022.

This framing goes well beyond El-Sayed. The idea that the Democratic Party is divided on …

author: Alexis Goldstein
title: As the AI Bubble Threatens to Burst, We Must Prepare to Fight a Big Tech Bailout
content:
As firms like CoreWeave and NVIDIA start to wobble, let’s demand that the public won’t be the one left holding the bag.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

AI data centers are unpopular for good reason: they drive up utility costs for communities, crowd out everything from schools to family farms, and they’re bad for our health. But these data centers are also a financial crisis in slow motion.

The AI ecosystem is built on mountains of debt taken on not only by tech firms like Meta (which borrowed a record-breaking $25 billion in late 2025 to fund the building of data centers), but also by the companies that lease data center space to the Big Tech firms. Many of these firms have spent far more than they have come close to earning in profits: One estimate puts tech industry spending to build data centers at $1.9 trillion, but less than half of that money has been made in revenue.

The financial markets are taking notice.

There’s been significant turmoil in the tech sector over the past month — and at one critical company in particular: CoreWeave.

CoreWeave used to be a Bitcoin mining firm called Atlantic Crypto, but it started to pivot to AI in 2019. CoreWeave leases space to Big Tech firms at data centers they build and maintain. CoreWeave has paid for most of its data centers by borrowing: it currently owes more than $51 billion to investors, including two of the most infamous financial firms: Magnetar and Blackstone, as documented by journalist Elizabeth Lopatto at The Verge.

CoreWeave’s troubles have been piling up: its stock lost a quarter of its value — a 25 percent drop — last week, then dropped another 10 percent on October 22. Bond investors are demanding more money if they’re going to take on the risk of buying CoreWeave debt, a sign the markets are worried about CoreWeave going bust. Investors used to be content to be paid 9.75 percent a year to loan CoreWeave money until 2031; now bond market investors won’t take that risk without being paid almost 15 percent in annual interest.

But perhaps the worst bit of news for CoreWeave is in the market’s falling confidence in its ability to survive, as measured by the cost of an instrument known as the credit default swap, which is essentially a bet that a company is going to go bankrupt (it’s also described as insurance against that company’s bankruptcy). The cost of buying a five-year-long credit default swap for CoreWeave has increased over 164 percent in the past year.

It’s not just CoreWeave facing trouble. One of the most significant companies in the AI ecosystem is NVIDIA, the graphics card maker, which, on September 28, spent $150 billion to buy back shares of its own stock from the overall market.

It was a record-breaking stock buyback — no other company in history had ever purchased that much of its own stock. One reason companies buy back their own stock is to artificially boost the stock price. Often the CEO’s compensation is tied to the price of the stock, and so the company purchases its own stock back to drive up the price, thus guaranteeing the CEO higher compensation.

The market sometimes perceives a stock buyback as a sign of confidence, reinforcing the idea that the company itself is underpriced. But in the case of NVIDIA, it seemed to be an indication that there’s nowhere higher to go, and the only way to raise the price of NVIDIA stock, which has been on a record tear, is to artificially boost it. Financial journalists have questioned NVIDIA’s ability to keep rocketing upward since late 2025. NVIDIA stock is down around 5 percent since this latest buyback.

AI has been sold to the general public as everything from a panacea to a danger to humanity to a roaring bull market, but it’s starting to look more like financial mania.

In late 2025, OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar caused a stir when she suggested the government should backstop AI firms like hers. Astra Taylor and Naomi Klein warned about the potential for an AI bailout in their new book End Times Fascism: And the Fight for the Living World, and propose a new disarmament movement.

To disarm the big tech bomb, including AI, the public needs to be on high alert — as AI firms start to visibly wobble, we need clear demands and firm commitments from our leaders that if it all comes crashing down, the public won’t be the one left holding the bag.

title: Assemblée générale en Hôtellerie - Café - Restauration
content:
Suite au 17 octobre et pour préparer le 5 novembre, le collectif Mise en Place appelle à une assemblée générale le jeudi 29 octobre.


Assemblée générale en Hôtellerie - Café - Restauration - Jeudi 29 octobre à 15h30 au 67 rue de Turbigo

 

!


Le 17 octobre a été une mobilisation d'une grande ampleur et combativité. On est beaucoup de ce secteur à s'être mobilisés mais c'est pas forcément évident pour nous, qui travaillons souvent le samedi de participer à ces manifestations. Beaucoup ont dû bricoler avec des demandes de congés payés par ci, ou des arrêts maladie par là.


Nous pensons qu'il est important de se retrouver pour échanger sur nos conditions de travail et préparer ensemble la riposte dans nos secteurs par la grève et par la mobilisations dans la rue.


D'autant plus que la riposte patronale s'organise dès maintenant dans notre secteur. En effet, le président de l'

UMIH

 (le syndicat patronal) a déclaré dans le journal Le Point que des «

 

dizaines de patrons l'ont appelé après la manifestation de samedi pour lui dire qu'ils allaient s'armer et faire appel à des milices pour défendre les restaurants

 

». Les ventes d'armes dans les armureries ont explosé et on observe effectivement l'émergence de groupes Telegram d'extrême droite qui s'organisent pour «

 

protéger les commerces

 

», autrement dit des milices proto-fascistes.


Aux côtés des gens qui, dans une démonstration d'une grande violence symbolique, ont formé une chaîne humaine pour “protéger les commerces” alors que des manifestants perdent leurs yeux, leurs mains, leur droit de vote ou même la vie, beaucoup de syndicats défendent ardemment la propriété privée. Selon eux, les pillages risqueraient de faire baisser les bénéfices des entreprises concernées, ce qui retomberait sur les salariés. Pourtant, autour de nous, nombreux sont les collègues épuisé·es de l'exploitation qui espèrent être mis au chômage technique afin de toucher 100% de leur salaire (comme l'a annoncé Lecornu) et de pouvoir s'organiser et participer aux différentes mobilisations.


C'est dans ce contexte qu'on appelle à se rassembler pour discuter de nos situations à nos tafs avec en vue les différentes mobilisations du samedi et l'appel à la grève de la

CGT

 à partir du 5 novembre.


Contre la vie chère et libération de tous les prisonnier·es

 

!


Collectif

MEP

Nach mehreren Warnstreiks im tschechischen Fernsehen (ČT) und Rundfunk (ČRo) und massiven Protesten soll am 3. November ganztägiger öffentlich-rechtlicher Streik folgen


Proteste in Tschechien für freien Rundfunk


„

Per Nachtsitzung treibt die Regierung die Abschaffung der Rundfunkgebühren voran. Kritiker fürchten eine staatliche Kontrolle nach ungarischem Vorbild.


Am Wochenende sind in Tschechien Tausende für die Unabhängigkeit des öffentlich-rechtlichen Rundfunks (ÖRR) auf die Straße gegangen. Einige wollten gewaltsam das Parlamentsgebäude stürmen. Der Anlass: In der Nacht auf Samstag hatte die Regierungsmehrheit im Abgeordnetenhaus einen Gesetzesentwurf gebilligt, wonach Fernsehen (ČT) und Rundfunk (ČRo) künftig aus dem Staatshaushalt finanziert werden sollen. Die Abschaffung der Rundfunkgebühren – derzeit 205 Kronen, etwa 8 Euro, pro Monat – hatte die Koalition aus der rechtspopulistischen ANO, der rechtsextremen SPD und der europaskeptischen Autofahrerpartei im Juni angekündigt. Nun soll alles ganz schnell gehen. Der Entwurf geht jetzt in den Medien- und Kulturausschuss und soll in wenigen Wochen endgültig beschlossen werden. Das Gesetz sieht zudem Kürzungen von rund 15 Prozent vor. Kritiker fürchten, dass der ÖRR zum Sprachrohr der Regierung werden könnte, ähnlich wie etwa in Ungarn unter dem inzwischen abgewählten Viktor Orbán.


Rundfunk-Gewerkschaft will streiken

title: Del cerco algorítmico a la grieta global: Lula, Haití, los estudiantes serbios y el desmoronamiento del centro europeo
content:
Palabras de un cimarrón digital de Nuestra Améfrica Ladina, a 534 años de la Resistencia Indígena Planetaria y en homenaje permanente al maestro Saúl Rivas Rivas.


Por Argenis José Delgado Vegas | Militante del

M

ovimiento

S

ocial

A

frovenezolano | Director de la Escuela Ideológica Social Afrodiaspórica de Venezuela | @ArgJoDel | 26 de octubre de 2026


_________________________________________________


Hermanas y hermanos de la diáspora, de los pueblos originarios, de las periferias urbanas y rurales de Nuestra Améfrica Ladina: escribo estas líneas desde el mismo lugar epistémico desde donde hemos pensado siempre la liberación. No desde el “punto cero” del universalismo abstracto que Grosfoguel desmontó con precisión quirúrgica, sino desde el cuerpo racializado, desde la

memoria del Cumbe, desde la herencia del

 cimarronaje

 y del resguardo.

 La Matriz Ideológica de la Dominación Occidental no es un bloque monolítico. Es un entramado en tensión permanente, que se recompone tras cada derrota y que afila sus armas allí donde los pueblos rebeldes osan salirse del guión. Pero el guión también se agrieta. La segunda vuelta brasileña del 25 de octubre, la victoria estudiantil en Serbia, la intervención militar salvadoreña en Haití, la carrera por la Secretaría General de la ONU y el desmoronamiento del centro político europeo son piezas de un mismo tablero. Y desde nuestra trinchera afrodiaspórica, tenemos la obligación de leerlas con los ojos de la descolonización.


Brasil: el tecnofascismo derrotado en su propio terreno


La victoria de Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en la segunda vuelta brasileña no fue una simple alternancia electoral. Fue la derrota del tecnofascismo en el terreno que la ultraderecha global había elegido como suyo: el de los algoritmos, las plataformas y la manipulación informativa. Lula cerró con el 51,74 % de los votos frente al 48,2 % de Flávio Bolsonaro, una remontada inédita desde el 45 % a 47 % adverso de la primera vuelta. El Tribunal Superior Electoral confirmó el resultado para un cuarto mandato que se extenderá de 2027 a 2030.


No fue una campaña convencional. Meta restringió los perfiles de Lula e intentó dar de baja canales de difusión masiva de simpatizantes de izquierda. La maquinaria del tecnofascismo —Palantir, los algoritmos de Silicon Valley, el aparato de desinformación de la élite trumpista— operó a plena capacidad. Y aun así perdió. La campaña de Lula se planteó, desde el inicio, “desde el cuidado de las mayorías empobrecidas y la protección de poblaciones vulnerables como lo son los pueblos originarios, frente a una opción que plantea recortar derechos”. Esa apuesta no fue retórica: fue la clave de una movilización que revirtió la desventaja algorítmica. Como dijo Grosfoguel, “el sistema imperialista mundial es un tigre de papel cuando los pueblos se organizan y luchan”.


La memoria de las políticas de inclusión y el voto de los vulnerables


El apoyo masivo que recibió Lula en la recta final no surgió de la nada. Fue el reflejo de una memoria colectiva construida durante sus gobiernos anteriores (2003-2010), cuando se crearon las secretarías especiales de Políticas para las Mujeres y de Promoción de la Igualdad Racial, se sancionó el Estatuto de la Igualdad Racial (Ley 12.288/2010) y se implementaron políticas como el Programa Brasil Sem Homofobia y el sistema de reconocimiento de tierras quilombolas. Para las comunidades afrobrasileñas, como el Quilombo Piqui da Rampa, Lula es “el padre, la madre y el abuelo”. Esa gratitud se tradujo en votos: en el noreste brasileño, donde se concentra la mayor población afrodescendiente del país, Lula obtuvo casi el 64 % en la primera vuelta.


Como militante afrovenezolano, sé lo que significa para una comunidad quilombola sentir que el Estado por fin la reconoce. En Venezuela hemos librado esa misma batalla por el reconocimiento constitucional de nuestros pueblos y comunidades afrodescendientes, por la visibilización del Cumbe, del conuco, de la memoria de Barlovento

, La Guaira, San Agustín, Costas de Aragua, Carabobo, Yaracuy, Altagracia de Orituco, Sierra de Falcón, Golfo de Cariaco y Paria, El Callao

 y del Sur del Lago

, entre otros

. La victoria de Lula es también nuestra victoria, porque demuestra que las políticas de inclusión racial no son un gasto: son una inversión en dignidad que los pueblos cobran en las urnas. La victoria también fue “una buena noticia para los pueblos indígenas

,

la comunidad LGBT, para los …

title: Nuevos paros de docentes universitarios y de maestros de la PBA
content:
Por Mario Hernandez


La

Conadu Histórica

 realizará un paro nacional docente desde el miércoles 28 de octubre hasta el martes 3 de noviembre inclusive, sin dictado de clases ni tareas docentes. La medida fue aprobada durante el Congreso del gremio realizado el 22 de octubre.


Las seccionales de

SUTEBA Multicolor

, opositoras a la conducción provincial del sindicato, anunciaron 48 horas de lucha para el martes 27 y miércoles 28 de octubre, con paros y jornadas de protesta en distintos distritos, en rechazo al acuerdo salarial del 6% que el gobierno de Axel Kicillof alcanzó con la mayoría de las organizaciones gremiales.


Congreso Extraordinario de CONADU HISTÓRICA del 22 de octubre de 2026


La Asociación de Docentes e Investigadores de la Universidad Nacional de la Patagonia Austral (ADIUNPA)

señaló

 que el reclamo incluye el cumplimiento efectivo de la Ley de Financiamiento Universitario, el pago de la deuda salarial y un presupuesto que garantice el funcionamiento de las universidades nacionales.


El gremio también cuestionó la política de ajuste del Gobierno nacional y sostuvo que afecta los salarios y las condiciones de trabajo en las casas de estudio. Además, repudió la represión durante la Quinta Marcha Federal Universitaria y planteó la necesidad de mantener la unidad entre las organizaciones.


La Mesa Ejecutiva de CONADU Histórica coordinará las medidas con las demás organizaciones del Frente Sindical de Universidades Nacionales. El 6 de noviembre, un nuevo Congreso Extraordinario evaluará la situación y definirá la continuidad del plan de lucha.


Por su parte,

el gremio no docente adherirá al primer día de protesta con un paro de 24 horas y anunció otras cuatro medidas de fuerza para noviembre

.


En la Universidad Nacional de Rosario


Los docentes de la Universidad Nacional de Rosario (UNR) anunciaron un nuevo paro que comenzará este miércoles 28 de octubre y resolvió extender la huelga durante una semana completa, en desacuerdo con el alcance del plan de lucha definido a nivel nacional por Conadu.


El cronograma anunciado por COAD contempla cinco jornadas de paro distribuidas entre fines de octubre y comienzos de noviembre. Las 3 primeras jornadas de paro quedarán efectivas durante la última semana de octubre, lo cual suspenderá las clases el miércoles 28, jueves 29 y viernes 30.


Además, según los anuncios difundidos por el organismo, la medida de fuerza se extendería durante los primeros días de noviembre.


Según el cronograma establecido, las clases para los alumnos quedarán interrumpidas los siguientes días:


Miércoles 28 de octubre


Jueves 29 de octubre


Viernes 30 de octubre


Lunes 2 de noviembre


Martes 3 de noviembre.


La medida responde al reclamo por el cumplimiento de la Ley de Financiamiento Universitario y la actualización de los salarios docentes. Desde COAD sostienen que el conflicto lleva un año sin resolverse y cuestionan la falta de aplicación de la norma.


Entre sus principales demandas, el gremio exige una recomposición salarial inmediata del 32% para recuperar el poder adquisitivo que los sueldos tenían en noviembre de 2023.


Al mismo tiempo, reclaman el pago de una suma equivalente a cinco salarios, que consideran adeudada por el Gobierno Nacional.


En su comunicado, la organización sostuvo: “El plan de lucha universitario continúa hasta que el gobierno cumpla la ley”. La decisión de profundizar las medidas se tomó después de que

el Congreso Extraordinario de CONADU rechazara una propuesta de paro por tiempo indeterminado y definiera un esquema de protestas más acotado

.


La jornada de inicio del paro está programada para el miércoles 28 de octubre, fecha en que se tratará el Presupuesto en comisión de la Cámara de Diputados de la Nación.


Además, se anunció movilización para el día que se trate el Presupuesto en el pleno de la citada Cámara. “En medio de esas fechas, el Congreso resolvió realizar jornadas de visibilización y protesta conforme defina cada asociación de base”, destaca en el comunicado publicado a través de su sitio web oficial este lunes 26 de octubre.

title: Llamamiento:  Por la paz y la soberanía de nuestros pueblos
content:
Las personas y organizaciones firmantes queremos expresar lo siguiente:


1 – Vemos  con profunda preocupación el aumento de gobiernos de extrema derecha los que no serían posibles sino contaran con el apoyo financiero de las grandes empresas y del gobierno de los EEUU y su maquinaria de propaganda en redes sociales donde se manipula la conciencia de los votantes no en favor de una mayor democracia ni bienestar social sino para que imperen gobiernos autoritarios los que no respetan plenamente los derechos humanos.


2 – El Escudo de las Américas impuesto por los Estados Unidos en América Latina es una amenaza al derecho de nuestros pueblos a su plena soberanía al imponer que fuerzas militares estadounidenses operen en nuestros países bajo el pretexto del combate al narcotráfico. Así mismo, el Escudo de las Américas retoma la Doctrina de la Seguridad Nacional perfilando quiénes son buenos y malos. Entre otros, pretende determinar e imponernos quiénes son “proveedores confiables” y resguardar las cadenas de suministro de minerales críticos y tierras raras en beneficio de los intereses de los EEUU.


3 – Llamamos al gobierno de los EEUU a poner fin al bloqueo a Cuba que representa un castigo colectivo contra la población cubana. Expertos de la ONU han señalado que EEUU “debe cesar todas las amenazas y actos hostiles contra la soberanía de Cuba y revocar todas las medidas que ha impuesto al país y que son contrarias al derecho internacional”. ¡¡Solidaridad sí, bloqueo nunca más!! 4 – Llamamos al gobierno de los EEUU e Israel a poner término a los ataques contra Palestina, el Líbano, Irán y Yemen. Así mismo, llamamos a los EEUU y los demás países de la OTAN a poner fin al envío de armas así como a la entrega de asistencia militar a Israel y Ucrania. Se deben poner fin a las guerras, no seguir apoyándolas. Pedimos a todos los gobiernos involucrados, donde haya conflicto, un alto al fuego y negociaciones de paz inmediatas.


5 – Así mismo, exigimos el fin de las cientos de bases militares de Estados Unidos repartidas por toda nuestra América Latina y el mundo, el fin de los ejercicios militares que se vienen realizando en nuestro continente como en toda Europa. Rechazamos la narrativa guerrerista de la OTAN y los preparativos de su población ante la posibilidad de una guerra nuclear. Es urgente que hablen y trabajen por la paz y la desmilitarización.


6 – Llamamos a todos nuestros gobiernos a reducir significativamente el gasto militar y destinar esos recursos para salud, vivienda, educación, cultura, protección del medioambiente, apoyo a las familias vulnerables, etc. Apoyamos las campañas internacionales contra el gasto militar. Dinero para la vida y la paz, es lo fundamental.


7 – Llamamos al Consejo de Seguridad de la ONU, como a todos los países miembros de la ONU, a realizar acciones reales y concretas para detener todos los conflictos bélicos en curso y lograr negociaciones y un alto el fuego. Es fundamental construir un compromiso de seguridad común donde todas las naciones se sientan seguras y se avance hacia una agenda de desarme y construcción de relaciones de confianza y colaboración entre todas las naciones. La humanidad tiene el derecho de vivir en paz.

author: Publicación Abierta
title: Brasil paró a la ultraderecha: ahora nos toca a nosotros
content:
El pueblo brasileño ha hablado


Brasil salió en masa a votar para parar a la ultraderecha, y la paró. Lula y el Partido de los Trabajadores han vuelto a ganar las elecciones frente a Flávio Bolsonaro, el candidato del clan bolsonarista, con más de cuatro millones de votos de diferencia: 64,2 millones frente a 59,8. Y no fue un paseo: Lula terminó la primera vuelta por detrás. La remontada es histórica y tiene un nombre: movilización. Millones de personas salieron a las calles, la abstención cayó y una sociedad que no quería a un lacayo de la ultraderecha internacional en el Palacio de Planalto hizo lo que había que hacer.


Las plataformas no votan, pero juegan


Hay un dato que no debe pasar desapercibido. Empleados de Meta han reconocido en mensajes internos, revelados por Folha de S.Paulo, que las cuentas de Lula en Instagram sufrieron restricciones, mientras la plataforma recomendaba el perfil de Flávio Bolsonaro y su canal de WhatsApp. Meta lo atribuye a errores técnicos; el Tribunal Superior Electoral tuvo que ordenarle que no limitara el alcance de los contenidos políticos de ninguno de los dos candidatos. Errores técnicos que, curiosamente, siempre caen del mismo lado. Pero cuando el pueblo se organiza y se moviliza, las injerencias, los bulos y las mentiras no sirven de nada.


La primera gran derrota del ejército de los vendepatrias


Es la primera gran derrota en América Latina de ese ejército de siervos, lacayos y vendidos que se alinea con Trump: los Milei, los Noboa, los Bukele y, aquí, los Feijóo, los Abascal y las Ayuso, junto a una larga lista de representantes de esa corriente por todo el mundo. Bolsonaro es lo mismo que Feijóo y Abascal, lo mismo que Ayuso o Milei: recortes de derechos, involución social, mucho miedo y siembra de odio y mentiras.


Pueden rechazar la comparación todo lo que quieran, pero todas sabemos que forman parte del mismo proyecto. No en vano, fue Ayuso quien condecoró a Milei con la Medalla Internacional de la Comunidad de Madrid. Antes la recibieron Guaidó y Noboa: la lista de Ayuso habla por sí sola.


Y Trump, aliado de Bolsonaro padre, castigó a Brasil con aranceles y sanciones tras la condena de este y celebró como una «gran victoria» el resultado de Bolsonaro hijo en la primera vuelta. Pretenden ganar con el apoyo de los dueños de las redes sociales y de los grandes medios, así como con el respaldo de Washington y Tel Aviv. Lo de Brasil demuestra que, cuando el pueblo despierta, su derrota está asegurada.


Aquí también podemos


Si Brasil pudo parar a la ultraderecha, nosotros también podemos hacerlo. Necesitamos una gran movilización y salir a votar en masa, porque somos más, somos mayoría en todos los sentidos y no podemos permitir que quienes pretenden liquidar nuestros derechos, nuestro presente y el futuro de nuestros hijos lleguen al Gobierno.


Brasil ha marcado el camino: organización, calle y urnas.


¡Até a vitória, sempre!


André Abeledo Fernández

author: Paula Slier
title: The War in Sudan and the Challenges of Mediation
content:
Less than two months after Sudan’s war began in April 2023, the then African Union (AU) Commission chair, Moussa Faki Mahamat, called it the ‘prototype’ for ‘African solutions to African problems’.


More than three years later, some of the most consequential diplomacy is taking place through processes that extend well beyond the continent: in Jeddah, Washington and through the Quad of the United States, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Egypt.


Africa has not been absent. On 23 September, the current AU Commission chair, Mahmoud Ali Youssouf, co-chaired with US envoy Massad Boulos the first joint meeting of the Quad and Quintet. The Quintet brings together the AU, the Intergovernmental Authority on Development (IGAD), the United Nations, European Union and the League of Arab States.


So the question is not where Africa is. It is why African diplomacy has struggled to make more of a difference. Part of the answer lies in the African mediation itself: competing initiatives and disagreements over who should lead and how the war should be handled. But there is another problem that no mediator has yet managed to overcome.


Khalid Omer Yousif, a former Minister of Cabinet Affairs in Sudan’s civilian-led transitional government, was part of the civilian leadership dealing with the military before the war. ‘Both sides intend to keep fighting until they achieve their political objectives,’ he says. ‘Neither has yet concluded that the table offers more than the battlefield, and as long as that holds, every negotiation is a pause for resupply.’ He says the problem predates the war. ‘From inside the negotiations, the central obstacle was clear: important military actors were not prepared to relinquish political power to a civilian authority. At the same time, Islamist networks remained deeply embedded in parts of the state and military establishment and saw a democratic transition as a threat to their return. The agreement on paper was often closer than the political will to implement it.’


Liesl Louw-Vaudran, the International Crisis Group’s Senior Adviser, African Union, points to an attempt by IGAD, the East African regional bloc, to bring the two sides together in December 2023.


She told me in a remote interview that, ‘IGAD came close to mediating between Burhan and Hemedti in December 2023, but that failed at the last minute’.


IGAD announced that General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, head of the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), and Rapid Support Forces (RSF) commander Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo, known as Hemedti, had agreed to an unconditional ceasefire and a face-to-face meeting. Sudan’s foreign ministry disputed parts of the account, while the two sides also disagreed over the terms and format of any meeting. A source close to the talks told Sudanese media outlet

Ayin Network

 that Burhan’s aides wanted the meeting limited to the two generals and Djibouti’s president, while Hemedti wanted IGAD leaders present as witnesses. The meeting never happened.


But Louw-Vaudran believes the problem with African mediation went beyond this failed attempt.‘I think the lacklustre response by the AU and IGAD has more to do with institutional weakness than what most people realise,’ she says. According to Louw-Vaudran, Moussa Faki established an expanded mechanism to deal with Sudan, but the AU Peace and Security Council believed it undermined its authority. At the same time, IGAD leaders believed the crisis should fall to them under the AU’s principle of subsidiarity. ‘In the end, the disagreements among the various IGAD leaders (Ruto, Kiir, Abiy, Museveni) also hampered any progress,’ she says.


General Abd al-Fattah al-Burhan of the SAF and General Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo (‘Hemedti’) of the RSF – who were allies before the current war – both wish to negotiate from a position of strength.


In June 2024, the AU Peace and Security Council directed that a panel of African heads of state, led by Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni, be set up to facilitate discussions between Burhan and Hemedti. But it went nowhere. ‘Neither the panel nor the extraordinary AU summit on Sudan, proposed by Museveni ever took place,’ Louw-Vaudran says.


African states are not necessarily neutral. title: Schöne neue Bundeswehr: Durch den Krieg in der Ukraine kehrt die Debatte um die Wehrpflicht zurück – die Schulstreiks auch
content:
Dossier


„Unter der Überschrift „Gerne in die Kaserne“ hält Martin Machowechz auf Zeit Online am 14. Mai ein Plädoyer dafür, die Wehrpflicht wieder einzuführen. Mit diesen Gedanken ist er nicht alleine, denn wie Ex-Punk Campino (auch auf Zeit Online) hadert auch der Autor mit Blick auf die Ukraine mit der eigenen Verweigerung der Wehrpflicht. Sein vermeintlich progressiver Vorschlag: Er will alle Geschlechter verpflichten. Denn die neue Wehrpflicht solle „freier, sogar fröhlicher“ sein und „für alle Milieus, für alle Geschlechter“ gelten. Superdivers also soll sie sein, unsere neue Bundeswehr. Ein Wohlfühlort für Transpersonen, BiPoCs, Menschen mit Behinderung – geradezu verlockend. (…) In Europa und in der Nato finden sich heute nur noch sehr wenige Staaten, die an der Wehrpflicht festhalten…“  

Kommentar von Bo Wehrheim vom 17. Mai 2022 in der taz online

title: Continua l’accanimento nei confronti di Sara: da venerdì sera ai domiciliari
content:
La Questura e la Procura di Torino hanno confezionato un aggravamento delle misure preventive nei confronti di Sara, giovane e generosa compagna del movimento torinese. 


Già con obbligo di dimora e rientri serali oltre alla disposizione di firma quotidiana, a seguito di alcune segnalazioni da parte della Digos, è stato predisposto l’aggravamento delle misure tramutandole in arresti domiciliari. 


Alcune di esse sono relative agli ultimi cortei avvenuti a Torino come in moltissime altre città d’Italia, in particolare il grande corteo di sabato 17 ottobre contro il carovita e il riarmo. Ricordiamo che anche in quell’occasione, a corteo concluso, la polizia ha deciso di caricare le persone ancora presenti in piazza Castello con lacrimogeni ad altezza uomo e con l’intento di spingere i manifestanti al di fuori del centro cittadino. In questa occasione Sara è stata individuata, insieme ad altri ed altre, prendere parte alla manifestazione. Questo è bastato, insieme alle segnalazioni relative alla manifestazione oceanica per la Palestina, per ottenere un aggravamento delle restrizioni in tempi da record. La richiesta è stata fatta venerdì e accolta venerdì stesso, notificata poi la sera stessa dalla Digos. E così, poco prima di un altro importante appuntamento per la città di Torino, ossia il corteo contro il riarmo e il carovita di sabato 24 ottobre, è stato applicato il dispositivo. Un’azione che va a colpire anche in un momento preciso, dato che è in corso il processo per la richiesta di sorveglianza speciale. 


Nelle carte si legge la riproposizione del solito apparato argomentativo: la Questura ha come compito esplicito quello di confezionare ad arte personaggi e profili che in qualche modo dovrebbero assumere un ruolo da “leader” delle piazze in quanto ne prendono parte in maniera attiva. I giornali non si tirano indietro nel comporre un quadro in cui la narrazione cucita ad hoc concorre alla costruzione di questa immagine che va a legittimare atti di accanimento giudiziario nei confronti di alcuni compagni e compagne. Quasi una psy-op dove alcuni, molto spesso giovani, vengono individuati come rappresentativi di una dimensione completamente diversa da come si profila nelle menti di pm e questurini. L’eterogeneità, la complessità, i rapporti materiali tra persone, dimensioni collettive, realtà sociali e contesti viene completamente cancellata. Rimossa per fare spazio a un riassunto superficiale e completamente fuorviante di come, nella loro testa, dovrebbero funzionare le situazioni collettive, che siano di piazza o altro. Si evince in maniera sistematica, e probabilmente frutto di una profonda ignoranza della storia del conflitto sociale e dei movimenti, il costante tentativo di ridurre tutto a una banalizzazione stupida e semplicistica. Il problema è che poi a pagarne le conseguenze sono compagni e compagne che da sempre prendono posizione in maniera chiara contro le ingiustizie e per contribuire alla costruzione di un futuro migliore. Ancora una volta sarà importante fare sentire tutta la nostra solidarietà nei confronti di chi oggi si trova privato della propria libertà! 


Sara libera! Tutti e tutte libere! 


da

title: „Im Namen der Sicherheit“ schreitet die Automatisierung bei Amazon voran als Beschleunigung der Störungen, Verletzungen und Entlassungen
content:
Dossier


„

Die Lieferstationen von Amazon werden im ganzen Land mit Robotern ausgestattet, was zu weniger Arbeitern und einer Beschleunigung der verbleibenden Arbeiter führt. In der Lieferstation, in der ich arbeite, haben die Arbeiter mit Trotz reagiert.

Die Amazon-Fulfillment-Zentren, in denen die Artikel verpackt werden, werden nach und nach automatisiert, aber bisher wurden die Auslieferungsstationen meist von Menschen bedient. Jetzt werden ganze Systeme nachgerüstet oder ganz abgeschafft, „im Namen der Sicherheit“ und „zum Wohle der Mitarbeiter“. Aber Automatisierung bedeutet, dass Arbeitnehmer entlassen, in neue Positionen versetzt oder zur Versetzung gezwungen werden

…“ engl.

Artikel von Alvin Gaine vom 26.6.2025 in LaborNotes


 („Amazon-Mitarbeiter trotzen dem Diktat der Automatisierung“, maschinenübersetzt) und mehr dazu/daraus:


„Quality Jobs Act“ soll Gesundheitsfolgen von algorithmischem Management regeln: EU-Abgeordnete besuchen Amazon-Lagerhäuser in Deutschland und Polen


ver.di-Bundesvorstand Silke Zimmer: „Politik muss Beschäftigte vor Profitgier schützen“ – EU-Abgeordnete besuchen Amazon-Standorte in Deutschland


„

Anlässlich des Besuchs von Mitgliedern des Europäischen Parlaments (MdEP) an den Amazon-Standorten in Dortmund und Mönchengladbach am Montag (26. Oktober 2026) kritisiert die Vereinten Dienstleistungsgewerkschaft (ver.di), dass Ansiedlungen von Amazon zumeist ohne Vorbehalte begrüßt würden, ohne die Folgen in den Blick zu nehmen. Anstatt Genehmigungen an Bedingungen zugunsten der Beschäftigten zu knüpfen, werde nur auf Gewerbesteuereinnahmen geblickt. „Wenn Amazon im nächsten Jahr plant, 16 Mrd. Euro in Deutschland zu investieren, klingt das für Gemeinden wie eine frohe Botschaft. Mit Amazon hält aber auch eine neue ‚Arbeits-Un-Kultur‘ Einzug. Deswegen ist es wichtig, die Rechte der Beschäftigten im Blick zu behalten und sie vor der Profitgier der Tech-Oligarchen zu schützen. Der europäische Gesetzgeber muss die psychische und physische Gesundheit der Menschen vor dem permanenten Zugriff der digitalen Datenkraken schützen“, betont ver.di-Bundesvorstandsmitglied Silke Zimmer. ver.di kritisiert seit mehr als einem Jahrzehnt, dass Amazons Hard- wie Software in den Warenlägern zur Überwachung missbraucht wird und zu steigendem Leistungsdruck sowie willkürlichen Sanktionen gegen Beschäftigte führt.


Die Delegation der MdEPs wird Amazon-Beschäftigte, Betriebsräte und Vertrauensleute der ver.di treffen, um aus erster Hand zu erfahren, wie sich Amazons Einsatz von technologischen Hilfsmitteln wie Kameras und algorithmisches Management auf die Gesundheit der Beschäftigten auswirkt. Die Erkenntnisse werden in den laufenden EU-Gesetzgebungsprozess zum „Quality Jobs Act“, der unter anderem algorithmisches Management und Gesundheit am Arbeitsplatz behandelt, einfließen. (…)

author: Unknown
title: Altun: Government must end delaying release of prisoners
content:
Kenan Altun, who had been imprisoned for 30 years, was released from Maltepe No. 1 L-Type Prison in recent days. Altun spoke to ANF about the Peace and Democratic Society Process, saying it had generated great enthusiasm among the people and that prisoners had also strongly embraced the process.


Altun said the Kurdish people had embraced the process, but certain approaches adopted by the government were raising concerns. He added that the situation in prisons was deepening these concerns, pointing to the importance of prison conditions for the progress of the process.


 


‘Prison practices are raising concerns about the process’


Altun drew attention to practices in prisons and said: “It is genuinely difficult to make sense of these practices and explain them to our people. The situation of our imprisoned comrades who have spent many years behind bars, particularly our elderly comrades, is deeply troubling for all of us. One example is Ali Rıza Yurtdaş, who was held in the prison I have just left. He is 84 years old. Despite being referred to the Forensic Medicine Institute several times during this process and having medical reports, he was arbitrarily declared ‘fit to remain in prison’. This is just one example. There are many others.


Apart from our ill comrades, there are prisoners who have served five, ten and even more than thirty years. Their release appears to have been left entirely to the arbitrary decisions of prison administrations and boards, without any reason or reasonable justification.


Just as the ‘resolution process’ is currently caught up in a decision-making mechanism involving the National Security Council, the fate and freedom of thousands of our comrades have been left to arbitrary prison boards that we could describe as ‘miniature National Security Councils’. This is causing serious concern and anger among our people and those around us.”


‘Prison administrations have no autonomy; decisions come from the centre’


Altun also criticised the continued restrictions on access to Imrali and said: “Despite Abdullah Öcalan's extremely positive approach, he remains in isolation. He has still not been able to meet with the people of Turkey, and there are difficulties and obstacles preventing his views on peace from reaching our people. These practices continue to be used almost as a form of blackmail and intimidation against our people and our comrades in prison.


Another striking aspect of this process is the vindictive and arbitrary treatment directed particularly at our female comrades. In many prisons, especially Sincan, our comrades are being given additional punishments of eight or nine months without any reasonable justification, as though they had committed a new ‘offence’ or were subject to disciplinary penalties that never expire. They are being kept in prison. I have only recently been released myself. Frankly, we can see these concerns outside prison as well. We demand an immediate end to these practices.”


Altun said the Peace and Democratic Society Process would gain much greater support if the government ended these practices. 


He continued: “The arbitrary practices of prison administrations are not the result of independent decisions. We know very well that they have no autonomy in these matters. There is a centrally directed approach. There is no justification for it. If the Ministry of Justice issues instructions, or if prison administrations receive instructions on this matter, the solution is very simple. Why are people who have no disciplinary penalties not being released? On what grounds?


On the one hand, the government calls on the guerrillas to come down from the mountains and enter civilian life. On the other, it tells our comrades who have spent thirty years in prison, ‘You cannot be released, you cannot adapt, you cannot reintegrate into society,’ or asks, ‘Are you remorseful?’ These are meaningless approaches that have nothing to do with the process. They provoke anger and undermine confidence in it. We demand that these practices be abandoned immediately.”


‘The government must end its delaying tactics’


Kenan Altun said peace was of great importance to both the Kurdish people and Turkish society, calling on the government to take swift, decisive and confidence-building steps to ensure that the process gained broader public support.


Altun said: “It is genuinely difficult to understand the reasons behind these delaying tactics. What are they calculating? …
